a: Avedna yoma tava lerabbanan. amar rava tete li, dechi ata tzureba merabbanan lekammay ledina, la mazegna reshi abbe sadya kamma dela mehappechna bezachuteh. amar mar bar rav ashe: pesilna leh letzureba merabbanan ledina. may tama? — dechabbiv alay kegufay, veen adam roe chova leatzmo.

Rabbi chanina miatef vekae appanya demaale shabbeta, amar: "bou venetze likrat shabbat hammalka". rabbi yannay lavesh mane mealleye (shabbat) [umikkasse], veamar: "boi challa, boi challa". rabba bar rav huna ikkela leve rabba bar rav nachman. karivu leh telat save tachye. amar lehu: mi hava yaditun deatena? amaru leh: mi adifat lan minna?

Rabbi abba zaven bitlesar istire peshite bisra mittelesar tabbache, umeshallem lehu atztzinnora dedashsha, vaamar lehu: "ashshur hayyay, ashshur hayyay". rabbi avahu hava yatev attachtaka deshinna umoshef nura. rav anan lavesh guneda, detana deve rabbi yishmael: begadim shebbishshel bahen kedera lerabbo — al yimzog bahen kos lerabbo.

Rav safra mecharech resha. rava malach shibbuta. rav huna madlek sherage. rav pappa gadel petilata. rav chisda parem silka. rabba verav yosef metzallechi tzive. rabbi zera metzattet tzattote. rav nachman bar yitzchak mechattef veayel, mechattef venafek. amar: illu mikkalin li rabbi amme verabbi assi, mi la mechattefna kammayyhu? veikka deamri: rabbi amme verabbi assi mechattefi veayyli, mechattefi venafki, amri: illu ikkela lan rabbi yochanan, mi la mechattefinan kammeh?!

Yosef mokar shabbe, hava hahu goy beshivavuteh dahava nefishi nichseh tuva. amri leh kaldae: kullehu nichse — yosef mokar shabbe achel lehu. azal zabbeninhu lechullehu nichse, zevan behu marganita, otva bisyayneh. bahade deka avar mabbara — afrecheh zika, shadyeh bemayya, baleh kavvra. asseku, ayytu appanya demaale shabbeta. amri: man zaven ki hasheta? amri lehu: zilu amteyu legabbe yosef mokar shabbe dirgil dezaven. amteyu nihaleh, zavneh, kareh ashkach beh marganita. zabbenay bitlesar illiyyata dedinare dedahava. pega beh hahu sava amar: man deyazef shabbeta — pareh shabbeta.

Bea minneh rabbi merabbi yishmael berabbi yose: ashirim shebbeeretz yisrael bamma hen zochin? amar leh: bishvil shemmeasserin, shenneemar: "asser teasser" — asser bishvil shettitashsher. shebbevavel bamma hen zochin? amar leh: bishvil shemmechabbedin et hattora.

Veshebbishar aratzot bamma hen zochin? amar leh: bishvil shemmechabbedin et hashshabbat. deamar rabbi chiyyay bar abba: paam achat nitarachti etzel baal habbayit beludekiyya, veheviu lefanav shulchan shel zahav massoy shishsha asar bene adam, veshesh esre shalshelaot shel kesef kevuot bo, ukearot vechosot vekitoniyyot utzelochiyyot kevuot bo, vealav kol mine maachol vechol mine megadim uvesamim. ucheshemmannichim oto omrim: "laAdonai haaretz umeloah vegomer". ucheshemmesallekin oto omrim: "hashshamayim shamayim laAdonai vehaaretz natan livne adam". amarti lo: beni bamme zachita lechach? amar li: katztzav hayiti, umikkol behema shehayta naa, amarti: zo tehe lashshabbat. amarti lo: [ashrecha shezzachita], uvaruch hammakom shezzikkecha lechach.

Amar lo kesar lerabbi yehoshua ben chananya: mippene ma tavshil shel shabbat recho nodef? amar lo: tavlin echad yesh lanu veshabbat shemo, sheanu metilin letocho verecho nodef. amar lo: ten lanu hemennu. amar lo: kol hameshammer et hashshabbat — moil lo, vesheeno meshammer et hashshabbat — eno moil lo.

Amar leh resh galuta lerav hamenuna: may dichtiv "velikdosh Adonai mechubbad"? amar leh: ze yom hakkippurim, sheen bo lo achila velo shetiyya, amra tora: kabbedehu bichsut nekiyya. "vechibbadto", rav amar: lehakedim, ushemuel amar: leacher. amaru leh bene rav pappa bar abba lerav pappa: kegon anan, dishchiach lan bisra vechamra kol yoma, bemay nishanneyeh? amar lehu: i regilitu leakdome — acharu, i regilitu leachoreh — akdemu. rav sheshet bekayta motev lehu lerabbanan hecha dematya shimsha. besitva motev lehu lerabbanan hecha dematya tulla, ki hechi delekumu hayyay. rabbi zera
b: Mehaddar azzuze zuze derabbanan, amar lehu: bematuta minnayychu la techalleluneh.

Amar rava, veittema rabbi yehoshua ben levi: afillu yachid hammitpallel beerev shabbat tzarich lomar "vaychullu", deamar rav hamenuna: kol hammitpallel beerev shabbat veomer "vaychullu", maale alav hakkatuv keillu naasa shuttaf lehakkadosh baruch hu bemaase vereshit, shenneemar: "vaychullu" — al tikre "vaychullu" ella "vaychallu". amar rabbi elazar: minnayin shehaddibbur kemaase — shenneemar: "bidvar Adonai shamayim naasu".

Amar rav chisda amar mar ukeva: kol hammitpallel beerev shabbat veomer "vaychullu", shene malache hashsharet hamelavvin lo laadam mannichin yedehen al rosho veomrim lo "vesar avonecha vechattatcha techuppar". tanya, rabbi yose bar yehuda omer: shene malache hashsharet melavvin lo leadam beerev shabbat mibbet hakkeneset leveto, echad tov veechad ra. ucheshebba leveto umotze ner daluk veshulchan aruch umittato mutztzaat, malach tov omer: "yehi ratzon shettehe leshabbat acheret kach", umalach ra one "amen" beal korcho. veim lav, malach ra omer: "yehi ratzon shettehe leshabbat acheret kach", umalach tov one "amen" beal korcho.

Amar rabbi elazar: leolam yesadder adam shulchano beerev shabbat, af al pi sheeno tzarich ella lichzayit. veamar rabbi chanina: leolam yesadder adam shulchano bemotzae shabbat, af al pi sheeno tzarich ella lichzayit. chammin bemotzae shabbat — melugema, pat chamma bemotzae shabbat — melugema. rabbi avahu hava avdin leh beappoke shabbeta igla tilta, hava achel minneh kuleyyta. ki gedal avimi bereh, amar leh: lema lach leafsode kulle hay, nishbok kuleyyta mimmaale shabbeta. shavku vaata arya achleh.

Amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: kol haone "amen yehe shemeh rabba mevarach" bechol kocho, korin lo gezar dino, shenneemar: "bifroa peraot beyisrael behitnaddev am barchu Adonai". may tama "bifroa peraot" — mishshum devarchu Adonai". rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: afillu yesh bo shemetz shel avoda zara — mochalin lo. ketiv hacha: "bifroa peraot", uchetiv hatam: "ki farua hu". amar resh lakish: kol haone "amen" bechol kocho potchin lo shaare gan eden, shenneemar: "pitchu shearim veyavo goy tzaddik shomer emunim", al tikre "shomer emunim" ella: "sheomrim amen". may "amen"? amar rabbi chanina: "el melech neeman".

Amar rav yehuda bereh derav shemuel mishshemeh derav: en haddeleka metzuya ella bimkom sheyyesh chillul shabbat, shenneemar: "veim lo tishmeu elay lekaddesh et yom hashshabbat ulevilti seet massa vegomer vehitztzatti esh bishareha veachla armenot yerushalaym velo tichbe". may "velo tichbe"? amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: beshaa sheen bene adam metzuyin lechabbotah. amar abbaye: la charva yerushalayim ella bishvil shechillelu bah et hashshabbat, shenneemar: "umishabbetotay helimu enehem vaechal betocham".

Amar rabbi avahu: lo charva yerushalayim ella bishvil shebbittelu keriat shema shacharit vearvit, shenneemar: "hoy mashkime vabboker shechar yirdofu vegomer", uchetiv: "vehaya chinnor vanevel tof vechalil vayayin mishtehem veet poal Adonai lo yabbitu", uchetiv: "lachen gala ammi mibbeli daat".

Amar rav hamenuna: lo charva yerushalayim ella bishvil shebbittelu bah tinokot shel bet rabban, shenneemar: "shefoch al olal bachutz vegomer". ma taam "shefoch" — mishshum deolal bachutz". amar ulla: lo charva yerushalayim ella mippene shello haya lahem boshet panim ze mizze, shenneemar: "hovishu ki toeva asu gam bosh lo yevoshu vegomer". amar rabbi yitzchak: lo charva yerushalayim ella bishvil shehushevu katan vegadol, shenneemar: "vehaya chaam kakkohen", uchetiv batreh: "hibbok tibbok haaretz".

Amar rav amram bereh derabbi shimon bar abba, amar rabbi shimon bar abba, amar rabbi chanina: lo charva yerushalayim ella bishvil shello hochichu ze et ze, shenneemar: "hayu sareha keayyalim lo matzu mire". ma ayil ze, rosho shel ze betzad zenavo shel ze, af yisrael shebbeoto haddor kavshu penehem bakkarka velo hochichu ze et ze. amar rabbi yehuda: lo charva yerushalayim ella bishvil shebbizzu bah talmide chachamim, shenneemar: "vayyihyu malivim bemalache haelohim uvozim devarav umittateim binviav ad alot chamat Adonai beammo ad [l]en marpe". may "ad leen marpe"? amar rav yehuda amar rav: kol hamevazze talmide chachamim en lo refua lemakkato.

Amar rav yehuda amar rav: may dichtiv "al tiggeu bimshichay uvinviay al tareu", "al tigu bimshichay" — ellu tinokot shel bet rabban, "uvinviay al tareu" — ellu talmide chachamim. amar resh lakish mishshum rabbi yehuda nesia: en haolam mitkayyem ella bishvil hevel tinokot shel bet rabban. amar leh rav pappa leabbaye: didi vedidach may? amar leh: eno dome hevel sheyyesh bo chet lehevel sheen bo chet. veamar resh lakish mishshum rabbi yehuda nesia: en mevattelin tinokot shel bet rabban afillu levinyan bet hammikdash. veamar resh lakish lerabbi yehuda nesia: kach mekkubbelani meavotay, veamri la meavotecha: kol ir sheen bah tinokot shel bet rabban macharivin otah, ravina amar: machrimin otah.

Veamar rava: lo charva yerushalayim ella bishvil sheppasku mimmenna anshe amana, shenneemar: "shottu bechutzot yerushalaym ureu na [udeu uvakshu virchovoteha im timtzeu ish] (im yesh ish) ose mishpat mevakkesh emuna veeslach lah". ini?! vehaamar rav kattina: afillu bishat kishlonah shel yerushalayim lo pasku mimmenna anshe amana, shenneemar: "ki yitpos ish beachiv bet aviv lemor simla lecha katzin tihye lanu", devarim shebbene adam mitkassin bahen kesimla yeshnan beyadecha. "vehammachshela hazzot tachat yadecha",

a: Devarim sheen bene adam omdin alehem ella im ken nichshalim bahen yeshnan tachat yadecha, "katzin tihye lanu". "yissa vayyom hahu lemor lo ehye chovesh vegomer" — en yissa ella leshon shevua, vechen hu omer "lo tissa et shem Adonai". "lo ehye chovesh" — lo ehye mechovshe atzman bevet hammidrash. "uveveti en lechem veen simla" — sheen beyadi lo mikra velo mishna velo gemara. umimmay? dilma shane hatam, dei amar lehu gemirna, amaru leh: ema lan. hava leh lememar gemar ushechach, may "lo ehye chovesh"? — kelal! la kashya: kan bedivre tora, kan bemassa umattan.

Mishna matztzilin sal male kikkarot, af al pi sheyyesh bo mea seudot, veiggul shel devela, vechavit shel yayin. veomer laacherim: bou vehatztzilu lachem. veim hayu pikchin, osin immo cheshbon achar hashshabbat.

Lehechan matztzilin otan — lechatzer hameorevet. ben betira omer: af lesheenah meorevet. ulesham motzi kol kele tashmisho, velovesh kol ma sheyyachol lilbosh, veotef kol ma sheyyachol laatof. rabbi yose omer: shemona asar kelim. vechozer velovesh umotzi, veomer laacherim: bou vehatztzilu immi.

Gemara veha tena leh resha shalosh seudot vetu la! amar rav huna: la kashya, kan — beva lehatztzil, kan — beva lekappel. uva lehatztzil — matztzil et kullan. ba lekappel — eno mekappel ella mezon shalosh seudot. rabbi abba bar zavda amar rav: idde veidde bava lekappel, vela kashya: kan — leotah chatzer, kan — lechatzer acheret. bae rav huna bereh derav yehoshua: peras tallito, vekippel vehinniach, vekippel vehinniach, may: keva lehatztzil dame, o keva lekappel dame?

Middeamar rava: ataye rav shezvi lerav chisda, uderash: uvilvad shello yavi keli shehu machazik yoter mishshalosh seudot, shema minna keva lehatztzil dame, veshappir dame. amar leh rav nachman bar yitzchak lerava: may tauta? amar leh, dekatane: uvilvad shello yavi keli acher veyiklot, keli acher vitzaref. keli acher hu dela, aval behahu mana — kamma devae matztzil.

Veiggul shel devela kulei. cheshbon may avidteh? mehefkera kazachu? — amar rav chisda: middat chasidut shanu kan. amar rava: chaside agra deshabbeta shakli?! ella amar rava: hacha bire shamayim askinan, vela nicha leh delithane meacherim, uvechinnam name la nicha leh delitrach. vehachi kaamar: veim hayu pikchin, deyadi dichhay gavvna lav sechar shabbat hu, osin immo cheshbon leachar hashshabbat.

Ulehechan matztzilin kulei. may shena hacha dekatane "lachem", umay shena hacha dekatane "immi"? amri: gabbe mezonot katane "lachem" — mishshum dela ka chaze ella mezon shalosh seudot. aval gabbe levushim katane "immi" — mishshum dekachaze leh lechulle yoma.

Tanu rabbanan: lovesh motzi ufoshet, vechozer velovesh umotzi ufoshet, vaafillu kol hayyom kullo — divre rabbi meir. rabbi yose omer: shemona asar kelim, veellu hem shemona asar kelim: miktoren, unekle, ufuneda, kalbos shel pishtan, vechaluk, veappilyon, umaporet, ushene safrekin, ushene minalim, ushene anpilaot, ushene pargod, vachagor shebbemotnav, vechova shebberosho, vesudar shebbetzavvaro.

Mishna rabbi shimon ben nannas omer: porsin or shel gedi al gabbe shidda teva umigdal sheachaz bahen et haur, mippene shehu mecharech. veosin mechitza bechol hakkelim, ben melein ben rekanim, bishvil shello taavor haddeleka. rabbi yose oser bichle cheres chadashim melein mayim, lefi sheen yecholin lekabbel et haur vehen mitbakkein umechabbin et haddeleka.

Gemara amar rav yehuda amar rav: tallit sheachaz bah haur mitztzad echad — notnin aleha mayim mitztzad acher, veim kavta — kavta. metivi: tallit sheachaz bah haur mitztzad echad — poshtah umitkasse bah, veim kavta — kavta. vechen sefer tora sheachaz bo haur — poshto vekore bo, veim kava — kava.
b: Hu deamar kerabbi shimon ben nannas.

Emar deamar rabbi shimon ben nannas "mippene shehu mecharech", geram kibbuy mi amar? in, middekatane sefa rabbi yose oser bichle cheres chadashim meleim mayim, sheenan yecholim lekabbel et haur vehen mitbakkein umechabbin et haddeleka — mikkelal detanna kamma share.
Tanu rabbanan: ner sheal gabbe tavla — menaer et hattavla vehi nofelet, veim kavta — kavta. amri deve rabbi yannay: lo shanu ella beshocheach, aval bemanniach — naasa basis ledavar haasur.

Tana: ner sheachore haddelet — poteach venoel kedarko, veim kavta — kavta. layet ala rav. amar leh ravina lerav acha bereh derava, veamri la rav acha bereh derava lerav ashe: may tama layet ala rav? illema mishshum derav savar la kerabbi yehuda, vetana katane la kerabbi shimon. mishshum derav savar la kerabbi yehuda, kol detane kerabbi shimon melat layet leh?!
Amar leh: beha afillu rabbi shimon mode. deha abbaye verava deamri tarvayyhu: mode rabbi shimon bifsik resheh vela yemut".

Amar rav yehuda: poteach adam delet keneged medura beshabbat. layet ala abbaye. bemay askinan? ilema beruach metzuya — may tameh deman deasar?! i beruach sheenah metzuya — may tama deman deshare?! leolam beruach metzuya: mar savar gazrinan, umar savar la gazrinan.

Osin mechitza kulei. lememra derabbanan savri geram kibbuy muttar, verabbi yose savar geram kibbuy asur? veha ippecha shaminan lehu. detanya: osin mechitza bechelim rekanin, uvimlein sheen darkan lehishtabber. veellu melein sheen darkan lehishtabber — kele mattachot. rabbi yose omer: af kele kefar shichin uchele kefar chananya en darkan lehishtabber. vechi tema: efoch matnitin, verabbi yose devarayyta ledivrehem kaamar. umi matzet afchat la? vehaamar rabba bar tachlifa mishshemeh derav: man tana geram kibbuy asur — rabbi yose!

Ella leolam la tefoch, uvarayyta kullah rabbi yose hi. vechassore mechassera vehachi katane: osin mechitza bechelim rekanin uvimleim sheen darkan lehishtabber. veellu hen kelim sheen darkan lehishtabber: kele mattachot. uchele kefar shichin uchele kefar chananya name en darkan lehishtabber, sherabbi yose omer: af keli kefar shichin uchele kefar chananya en darkan lehishtabber.

Verame derabbanan adderabbanan, verame derabbi yose adderabbi yose. detanya: hare shehaya shem katuv lo al besaro — hare ze lo yirchotz velo yasuch velo yaamod bimkom hattinnofet. nizdammena lo tevila shel mitzva — korech aleha gemi, veyored vetovel. rabbi yose omer: leolam yored vetovel kedarko, uvilvad shello yeshafshef!
Shane hatam deamar kera: "veibbadtem et shemam min hammakom hahu lo taasun ken laAdonai elohechem" — asiyyay hu deasur, gerama shere.
I hachi, hacha name, ketiv: "lo taase [chol] melacha" — asiyyay hu deasur, gerama shere! mittoch sheadam bahul al mamono, i sharet leh — ate lechabboye.
I hachi kashya derabbanan adderabbanan: uma hatam deadam bahul al mamono — shere, hacha lo kol shekken?!

Vetisbera hay gemi hechi dame? i demihaddak — ka have chatzitza, i la mihaddak — ayyli beh mayya! chatzitza, tippok leh mishshum deyo! belacha. detanya: haddam vehaddeyo haddevash vehechalav, yeveshin — chotztzin, lachim — en chotztzin. mikkol makom kashya?
Ella amar rava bar rav shela, hayeynu tamayyhu derabbanan, dekasavri: asur laamod bifne hashshem arom. mikkelal derabbi yose savar muttar laamod bifne hashshem arom? demannach yedeh illaveh.

Lerabbanan name, demannach yedeh illaveh! zimnin demishtele veshakel leh. lerabbi yose name, zimnin demishtele veshakel leh? ella: i deikka gemi — hachi name, hacha bemay askinan — lehaddore aggemi, rabbanan savri

a: Tevila bizmannah lav mitzva umahderinan, verabbi yose savar tevila bizmannah mitzva vela mahderinan.

Vesavar rabbi yose tevila bizmannah mitzva? vehatanya: hazzav vehazzava, hametzora vehametzoreet, boel nidda uteme met, tevilatan bayyom. nidda veyoledet — tevilatan ballayla. baal keri — tovel veholech kol hayyom kullo. rabbi yose omer: min hammincha ulemala eno tzarich litbol! hahi, rabbi yose berabbi yehuda hi, deamar: dayyay tevila baacharona.
Mishna goy shebba lechabbot — en omrim lo "kabbe" veal techabbe", mippene sheen shevitato alehen. aval katan shebba lechabbot — en shomin lo, mippene sheshshevitato alehen.

Gemara amar rabbi amme: bidleka hittiru lomar "kol hamechabbe eno mafsid". nema mesayyay leh: goy shebba lechabbot — en omrim lo "kabbe" veal techabbe" mippene sheen shevitato alehen. "kabbe" hu dela amrinan leh, ha "kol hamechabbe eno mafsid" — amrinan leh. ema sefa, "al techabbe" la amrinan leh, vechol hamechabbe eno mafsid" name la amrinan leh. ella meha lekka lemishma minna.

Tanu rabbanan: maase venafla deleka bachatzero shel yosef ben simay beshichin, uvau anshe gistera shel tzippori lechabbot, mippene sheappitroppos shel melech haya, velo hinnichan mippene kevod hashshabbat, venaasa lo nes veyardu geshamim vechibbu. laerev shigger lechol echad mehen shete selain, velaipparchos shebbahen — chamishshim. uchesheshshamu chachamim bedavar, amru: lo haya tzarich lechach, shehare shaninu: goy shebba lechabbot — en omrim lo "kabbe" veal techabbe".

Aval katan shebba lechabbot en shomin lo mippene sheshshevitato alehen. shamat minna katan ochel nevelot, bet din metzuvvivyn alav lehaferisho. amar rabbi yochanan: bekatan haose ledaat aviv. dichvota gabbe goy, deka aved ledateh deyisrael — mi shere?! goy ledateh denafsheh aved.

Mishna kofin keara al gabbe hanner bishvil shello teechoz bakkora, veal tzoa shel katan, veal akrav shello tishshach. amar rabbi yehuda: maase ba lifne rabban yochanan ben zakkay baarav, veamar: choshshani lo mechattat.
Gemara rav yehuda verav yirmeya bar abba verav chanan bar rava ikkelau leve avin demin neshikya. lerav yehuda verav yirmeya bar abba
b: Ayyto lehu pureyayta, lerav chanan bar rava la ayyto leh. ashkecheh matne leh livreh: veal tzoa shel katan mippene katan. amar leh: avin shatya matne shetuta livneh, vahalo hi atzmah muchenet lichlavim! vechi tema dela chazya leh meetmol — vehatanya: neharot hammoshchin umaayaynot hannovin — hare hen keragle kol adam.
Veella hechi atneyeh? ema: al tzoa shel tarnegolim mippene katan.

Vetippok leh dehave geraf shel rei! vechi tema: geraf shel rei aggav mana — in, ihu gufeh — la, veha hahu achbar deishtechach beisparmake derav ashe, vaamar lehu: niktu betzutziteh veappeku! beashpa. vekatan beashpa may bae leh? bechatzer. chatzer name, geraf shel rei hu! beashpa shebbechatzer.

Veal akrav shello tishshach. amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: kol hammazzikin neheragin beshabbat. metiv rav yosef: chamishsha neheragin beshabbat, veellu hen: zevuv shebbeeretz mitzrayim, vetzira shebbeninve, veakrav shebbechadyayv, venachash shebbeeretz yisrael, vechelev shote bechol makom. manni? ilema rabbi yehuda — ha amar: melacha sheenah tzericha legufah chayyayv aleha. ella lav rabbi shimon, vehane hu deshare, acharine — la!
Amar rabbi yirmeya: uman nema lan deha metaratzta hi? dilma meshabbashta hi? amar rav yosef: ana matnena la, veotevna la, vaana metaretzna la: beratzin acharav, vedivre hakkol.

Tane tanna kammeh derava bar rav huna: hahoreg nechashim veakrabbim beshabbat — en ruach chasidim nocha hemennu. amar leh: veotan chasidim en ruach chachamim nocha mehem. ufeliga derav huna. derav huna chazyeh lehahu gavra deka katel zibbura, amar leh: shallemtinhu lechullehu?

Tanu rabbanan: nizdammenu lo nechashim veakrabbim, haragan — beyadua shennizdammenu lo lehorgan. lo haragan — beyadua shennizdammenu lehorgo venaasa lo nes min hashshamayim. amar ulla veittema rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: benishshofin bo.
Amar rabbi abba bar kahana: paam achat nafal echad bevet hammidrash, veamad nivti echad vaharago. amar rabbi: paga bo kayyotze bo!

Ibbaya lehu: "paga bo kayyotze bo" deshappir avad, o la? ta shema, derabbi abba bereh derabbi chiyyay bar abba verabbi zera havo yatvi akkila deve rabbi yannay. nefak milleta mibbenayyhu, beo minneh merabbi yannay: mahu laharog nechashim veakrabbim beshabbat? amar lehu: tzira ani horeg, nachash veakrav — lo kol shekken?! dilma lefi tummo. daamar rav yehuda: rok dorso lefi tummo. veamar rav sheshet: nachash dorso lefi tummo. veamar rav kattina: akrav dorso lefi tummo.

Abba bar marta dehu abba bar minyome havo masseki beh deve resh galuta zuze. ayytyu, ka metzaari leh. hava shede rukka. amar lehu resh galuta: ayyto mana sechifu illaveh, amar lehu: la tzerichitu, hachi amar rabbi yehuda: rok dorso lefi tummo. amar lehu: tzureba merabbanan hu, shivku.
Amar rabbi abba bar kahana amar rabbi chanina: pamotot shel bet rabbi muttar letaltelan beshabbat, amar leh rabbi zera: benittalin beyado achat, o bishte yadayim?

a: Amar leh: keotan shel bet avicha.
Veamar rabbi abba bar kahana amar rabbi chanina: keronot shel bet rabbi muttar letaltelan beshabbat. amar leh rabbi zera: benittalin beadam echad o bishne bene adam? amar leh: keotan shel bet avicha.
Veamar rabbi abba bar kahana: hittir lahem rabbi chanina levet rabbi lishtot yayin bikronot shel goy, bechotam echad, vela yadana i mishshum desavar la kerabbi eliezer, i mishshum emta deve nesia.

Mishna goy shehidlik et hanner — mishtammesh leoro yisrael. veim bishvil yisrael — asur. mille mayim lehashekot behemto — mashke acharav yisrael, veim bishvil yisrael — asur. asa goy kevesh lered bo — yored acharav yisrael, veim bishvil yisrael — asur. maase berabban gamliel uzekenim shehayu bain bisfina veasa goy kevesh lered bo, veyardu bo rabban gamliel uzekenim.
Gemara utzericha, dei ashmeinan ner, mishshum dener leechad ner lemea, aval mayim ligzar, dilma ate leapposhe bishvil yisrael. vechevesh lema li? maase derabban gamliel uzekenim ka mashma lan.

Tanu rabbanan: goy shellikket asavim — maachil acharav yisrael, veim bishvil yisrael — asur. mille mayim lehashekot behemto — mashke acharav yisrael, veim bishvil yisrael — asur. bamme devarim amurim — sheen makkiro, aval makkiro — asur.
Ini?! vehaamar rav huna amar rabbi chanina: maamid adam behemto al gabbe asavim beshabbat, aval lo al gabbe muketze beshabbat. dekaem la beappah, veazla hi veachla.
Amar mar: bamme devarim amurim — sheen makkiro, aval makkiro — asur. ha rabban gamliel makkiro hava! amar abbaye: shello befanav hava. rava amar: afillu tema befanav, ner leechad ner lemea.
Metivi, amar lahen rabban gamliel: hoil veshello befanenu asao — nered bo. ema: hoil vaasao nered bo.

Ta shema: ir sheyyisrael vegoyim darin betochah, vehayta bah merchatz hammarchetzet beshabbat, im rov goyim — muttar lirchotz bah miyyad. im rov yisrael — yamtin bichde sheyyechammu chammin! hatam, ki mechammemi — addata derubba mechammemi.
Ta shema: ner haddaluk bimsibba, im rov goyim — muttar lehishtammesh leorah, im rov yisrael — asur, mechetza al mechetza — asur. hatam name, ki madleki —
b: Addata derubba madleki.
Shemuel ikkela leve avi toran. ata hahu goy adlek sheraga. ahderinhu shemuel leappeh. kevan dachaza deayyti shetar veka kare, amar: addata denafsheh hu deadlek. ahderinhu ihu leappeh gabbe sheraga.
Haderan alach kol kitve
Mishna kol hakkelim nittalin bashshabbat, vedaltotehen immahen, af al pi shennitparku bashshabbat. sheenan domin ledaltot habbayit, lefi sheenan min hammuchan.
Notel adam kurenas — lefatztzea bo et haegozin, kardom — lachtoch bo et haddevela. megera — lagor bah et haggevina. magrefa — ligrof bah et haggerogrot.
Et harachat veet hammalgez — latet alav lekatan. et hakkush veet hakkarker — litchov bo. machat shel yad — littol bo et hakkotz. veshel sakkaim — liftoach bo et haddelet.
Gemara kol hakkelim nittalin, veaf al pi shennitparku bashshabbat, vela mibbaya bechol.
Adderabba, bashshabbat muchanin al gabbe avihen, bachol en muchanin al gabbe avihen!
Amar abbaye, hachi kaamar: kol hakkelim nittalin bashshabbat vedaltotehen immahen. af al pi shennitparku bachol — nittalin bashshabbat.
Tanu rabbanan: delet shel shidda veshel teva veshel migdal — notlin aval lo machazirin. veshel lul shel tarnegolim — lo notlin velo machazirin.
Bishlama shel lul shel tarnegolim, kasavar: kevan dimchabberi beara — yesh binyan bekarka yesh setira bekarka. ella shel shidda veshel teva veshel migdal, may kasavar?
I kasavar yesh binyan bechelim — yesh setira bechelim, vei en setira bechelim — en binyan bechelim?
Amar abbaye: leolam kasavar yesh binyan bechelim veyesh setira bechelim, veshennittelu kaamar.
Amar leh rava: [shete teshuvot baddavar]. chada, denittalin" katane, veod: may "aval lo machazirin"? ella amar rava, kasavar: en binyan bechelim veen setira bechelim — ugezera shemma yitka.
Notel adam kurenas kulei. amar rav yehuda: kurenas shel egozin lefatztzea bo et haegozin, aval shel nappachin — lo.
Kasavar davar shemmelachto leissur, afillu letzorech gufo — asur.
Amar leh rabba: ella meatta, sefa dekatane: veet harachat veet hammalgez latet alav lekatan, rachat umalgez mi meyaychadi leh lekatan?! ella amar rabba: kurenas shel nappachin lefatztzea bo haegozin,
Kasavar:

a: Davar shemmelachto leissur letzorech gufo — muttar.
Etiveh abbaye lerabba: medocha, im yesh bah shum — metaltelin otah, veim lav — en metaltelin otah.
Amar leh: ha manni — rabbi nechemya hi, deamar: en keli nittal ella letzorech tashmisho.
Etiveh: (bet shammay omrim: en notlin et haeli lekatztzev alav basar. uvet hillel mattirin.) veshavin sheim kitztzev alav basar sheasur letaltelo!

Sevar leshannoye leh kerabbi nechemya. kevan deshama leha deamar rav chinnana bar shelemya mishshemeh derav: hakkol modim besikke zeyayre umazure dechevan dekafed alayyhu, meyayched lehu makom — ha name meyayched lehu makom.
Ittemar. rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: kurenas shel zehavim shaninu. rav shemen bar abba amar: kurenas shel bassamim shaninu.
Man deamar devassamim, kol shekken dezehavim. man deamar shel zehavim — aval devassamim kafed alayyhu.
Veet hakkush veet hakkarker kulei. tanu rabbanan: paga shettemanah beteven vacharara shettemanah begechalim, im megulla miktzatah — muttar letaltelah, veim lav — asur letaltelah.
Rabbi elazar ben tadday omer: tochavan bakkush o bakkarker, vehen ninarot meelehen. amar rav nachman: halacha kerabbi elazar ben tadday!
Lememra desavar rav nachman tiltul min hatztzad la shemeh tiltul? vehaamar rav nachman: hay pugela, millemala lematta — shere, mimmatta lemala — asir! hadar beh rav nachman mehahi.
Machat shel yad littol bah kulei. shelach leh rava bereh derabba lerav yosef: yelammedenu rabbenu, machat shennittal chararah o uketzah, mahu?
Amar leh, tenetuha: machat shel yad littol bah et hakkotz: vechi ma ichpat leh lakkotz ben nekuva leven sheenah nekuva?
Etiveh: machat shennittal chararah o uketzah — tehora?
Amar abbaye: tumea ashshabbat karamet? tumea keli maase baenan, leinyan shabbat midde dachaze baenan — veha name chazya lemishkal ba kotz.
Amar rava: man dekamotev, shappir kamotev. middilinyan tumea lav mana hu — leinyan shabbat name lav mana hu.
Metivi: machat, ben nekuva ben sheenah nekuva — muttar letaltelah beshabbat. velo amru nekuva ella leinyan tumea bilvad!
Targema abbaye allibba derava: beguleme askinan, zimnin demimmelich alayyhu, umeshavve lehu mana. aval hecha denittal chararah o uketzah — adam zorkah leven gerutaot.
Assove yanoka — rav nachman asar, verav sheshet share. amar rav nachman: mena amena la, ditnan: en osin
b: Appiktevizin bashshabbat. verav sheshet: hatam — lav orcheh, hacha — orcheh.
Amar rav sheshet: mena amena la — ditnan: machat shel yad — littol bah et hakkotz! verav nachman: hatam — pekid, hacha — la pekid.
Mishna kane shel zetim, im yesh kesher berosho — mekabbel tumea, veim lav — en mekabbel tumea. ben kach uven kach — nittal bashshabbat.
Gemara ammay? peshute chele etz hu, ufeshute chele etz enan mekabbelin tumea, may tama? — dumeya desak baenan. tana mishshemeh derabbi nechemya: beshaa shemmehappech bezetim hofcho veroe bo.
Mishna rabbi yose omer: kol hakkelim nittalin, chutz min hammassar haggadol veyated shel macharesha.
Gemara amar rav nachman: hay uchela dekatztzare — keyated shel macharesha damya.
Amar abbaye: charba deushekafe vesakkina deashkavta vachatzina denaggare — keyated shel macharesha dame.

Tanu rabbanan: barishona hayu omrim shelosha kelim nittalin bashshabbat: miktzoa shel devela, vezuhama listeron shel kedera, vesakkin ketanna sheal gabbe shulchan. hittiru, vechazru vehittiru, vechazru vehittiru, ad sheamru: kol hakkelim nittalin bashshabbat, chutz min massar haggadol veyated shel macharesha.
May hittiru, vechazru vehittiru, vechazru vehittiru?

Amar abbaye: hittiru davar shemmelachto lehetter letzorech gufo, vechazru vehittiru davar shemmelachto lehetter letzorech mekomo, vechazru vehittiru davar shemmelachto leissur, letzorech gufo — in, letzorech mekomo — la. vaadayin beyado achat — in, bishte yadav — la, ad sheamru: kol hakkelim nittalin bashshabbat, vaafillu bishte yadayim.

Amar leh rava: mikkede "hittiru" katane, ma li letzorech gufo, ma li letzorech mekomo? ella amar rava: hittiru davar shemmelachto lehetter ben letzorech gufo uven letzorech mekomo, vechazru vehittiru mechamma latztzel. vechazru vehittiru davar shemmelachto leissur, letzorech gufo uletzorech mekomo — in, mechamma latztzel — la. vaadayin, beadam echad — in, bishne bene adam — la, ad sheamru: kol hakkelim nittalin bashshabbat, afillu bishne bene adam.

Etiveh abbaye: medocha, im yesh bah shum — metaltelin otah, veim lav — en metaltelin otah? hacha bemay askinan — mechamma latztzel. etiveh: veshavin sheim kitztzev alav basar sheasur letaltelo? hacha name mechamma latztzel.
Amar rabbi chanina: bime nechemya ben chachalya nishnet mishna zo, dichtiv: "bayyamim hahemma raiti vihuda dorchim gittot bashshabbat umeviim haaremot".
Amar rabbi elazar: kanin, umaklot, gelusetra, umedocha — kullan kodem hattarat kelim nishnu.
Kanin — ditnan: lo siddur hakkanin velo netilatan docha et hashshabbat.
Maklot — ditnan: maklot dakkin chalakin hayu sham, umannicho al ketefo veal ketef chavero, vetole umafshit. amar rabbi elazar: arbaa asar shechal lihyot beshabbat, manniach

a: Yado al ketef chavero veyad chavero al ketefo, vetole umafshit.
Gelostera — ditnan: neger sheyyesh berosho gelostera, rabbi yehoshua omer: shomtah min petach ze vetolah bachavero beshabbat. rabbi tarfon omer: hare hu kechol hakkelim umittaltel bechatzer.
Medocha — ha daamaran. amar rabba: mimmay, dilma leolam ema lecha leachar hattarat kelim nishnu: kanim tama may — mishshum iapposhe, behay pureta la miappash. maklot, efshar kerabbi elazar.

Gelostera — kidrabbi yannay, daamar rabbi yannay: bechatzer sheenah meorevet askinan, rabbi yehoshua savar: toch happetach kelifnim dame vekamtaltel mana devattim bechatzer. verabbi tarfon savar: toch happetach kelachutz dame, umana dechatzer bechatzer ka metaltel.
Medocha — rabbi nechemya hi.
Mishna kol hakkelim nittalin letzorech veshello letzorech. rabbi nechemya omer: en nittalin ella letzorech.
Gemara may "letzorech" umay "shello letzorech"?

Amar rabba: "letzorech" — davar shemmelachto lehetter letzorech gufo. "shello letzorech" — davar shemmelachto lehetter letzorech mekomo, vedavar shemmelachto leissur, letzorech gufo — in, letzorech mekomo — la. vaata rabbi nechemya lememar vaafillu davar shemmelachto lehetter, letzorech gufo — in, letzorech mekomo — la. amar leh rava: letzorech mekomo, "shello letzorech" karet leh?!

Ella amar rava: "letzorech" — davar shemmelachto lehetter, ben letzorech gufo ben letzorech mekomo. "shello letzorech" — vaafillu mechamma latztzel. vedavar shemmelachto leissur, letzorech gufo uletzorech mekomo — in, mechamma latztzel — la. vaata rabbi nechemya lememar: vaafillu davar shemmelachto lehetter, letzorech gufo uletzorech mekomo — in, mechamma latztzel — la.
Yatev rav safra verav acha bar huna verav huna bar chanina, veyatvi vekaamri: lerabba allibba derabbi nechemya hane kearot hechi metaltelinan? amar lehu rav safra: midde dehave aggeraf shel rei.
Amar leh abbaye lerabba, lemar allibba derabbi nechemya, hane kearot hechi metaltelinan lehu? amar leh: rav safra chavrin targema: midde dehave aggeraf shel rei.

Etiveh abbaye: medocha, im yesh bah shum — metaltelin otah, veim lav — en metaltelin otah. hacha bemay askinan — mechamma latztzel. etiveh: veshavin sheim kitztzev alav basar sheasur letaltelo! hacha name mechamma latztzel.

Veha ditnan: en somchin et hakkedera bivkaat vechen baddelet. veha bekaat divyom tov davar shemmelachto lehetter hu, alma davar shemmelachto lehetter ben letzorech gufo ben letzorech mekomo — asur! hatam may tama — kevan divshabbat davar shemmelachto leissur hu, gezera yom tov attu shabbat.
Vechi tema: shabbat gufeh tishtere, deha davar shemmelachto leissur, letzorech gufo uletzorech mekomo shere — hane mille hecha deikka torat keli alav, hecha delekka torat keli alav — la.
Umi gazrinan? vehatnan: mashshilin perot derech arubba beyom tov, aval lo beshabbat!
Umi la gazrinan? vehatnan: en ben yom tov lashshabbat ella ochel nefesh bilvad!

Amar rav yosef, la kashya: ha — rabbi eliezer, ha — rabbi yehoshua. detanya: "oto veet beno" shennaflu levor, rabbi eliezer omer: maale et harishon al menat leshochto, veshochato. vehashsheni — ose lo parnasa bimkomo bishvil shello yamut. rabbi yehoshua omer: maale et harishon al menat leshochto, veeno shochato, umaarim umaale et hashsheni, ratza — ze shochet, ratza — ze shochet.
Mimmay? dilma ad kan la kaamar rabbi eliezer hatam ella deefshar befarnasa, aval hecha dela efshar befarnasa la.
I name, ad kan la kaamar rabbi yehoshua hatam deefshar behaarama, aval hecha dela efshar behaarama — la!
Ella amar rav pappa: la kashya, ha — bet shammay, ha — bet hillel. ditnan, bet shammay omrim:
b: En motziin et hakkatan veet hallulav veet sefer tora lirshut harabbim, uvet hillel mattirin.
Emar deshamat lehu levet shammay hotzaa, tiltul mi shamat lehu? vetiltul gufeh lav mishshum hotzaa hi?!
Veaf rav savar la leha derava. deamar rav: mar shello yigganev — zehu tiltul shello letzorech, veasur. tama shello yigganev, aval letzorech gufo uletzorech mekomo — muttar.
Ini?! veha rav kahana ikkela leve rav, vaamar: ayyto leh shuta lechahana littiv ala. lav lememra dedavar shemmelachto leissur, letzorech gufo — in, letzorech mekomo — la!
Hachi amar lehu: shekulu shuta mikkamme kahana. vei baet ema: hatam mechamma latztzel hava.

Rav mari bar rachel hava leh hahu be sadyevata beshimsha. ata lekammeh derava, amar leh: mahu letaltolinhu? amar leh: shere. it li acharina. chazu leorchin. it li name leorchim. amar leh: gallit addataych dichrabba sevira lach. lechulle alma shere, ledidach asir.
Amar rabbi abba amar rabbi chiyyay bar ashe amar rav: machbedot shel melat — muttar letaltelan beshabbat, aval shel temara — la.

Rabbi elazar omer: af shel temara. bemay askinan? ilema letzorech gufo uletzorech mekomo — beha lema rav shel temara la? veha rav kerava sevira leh. ella mechamma latztzel: beha lema rabbi elazar af shel temara? leolam mechamma latztzel, ema: vechen amar rabbi elazar.
Mishna kol hakkelim hannittalin bashshabbat — shivrehen nittalin immahen, uvilvad sheyyehu osin meen melacha.
Shivre areva lechassot bahen et pi hechavit, shivre zechuchit lechassot bahen et pi happach.
Rabbi yehuda omer: bilvad sheyyehu osin meen melachtan: shivre areva latzuk letochan mikpa, veshel zechuchit latzuk letochan shemen.
Gemara amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: machaloket shennishberu meerev shabbat, demar savar meen melachtan — in, meen melacha acheret — la. umar savar: afillu meen melacha acheret.
Aval nishberu beshabbat — divre hakkol muttarin. hoil umuchanin al gabbe avihen — muttar.
Motev rav zutera: massikin bechelim, veen massikin beshivre chelim.
Denishberu emat? illema denishberu meerev yom tov? — etzim bealma ninhu! ella lav beyom tov, vekatane: massikin bechelim veen massikim beshivre chelim!

Ella i ittemar, hachi ittemar: amar rav yehuda amar shemuel machaloket shennishberu beshabbat, demar savar muchan hu, umar savar nolad hu, aval meerev shabbat — divre hakkol muttarin, hoil vehuchenu limlacha mibbeod yom.

Tane chada: massikin bechelim, veen massikin beshivre chelim. vetanya iddach: keshem shemmassikin bechelim, kach massikin beshivre chelim. vetanya iddach: en massikin lo bechelim vela beshivre chelim.
Ha — rabbi yehuda. ha — rabbi shimon. ha — rabbi nechemya.
Amar rav nachman: hane livne deishtayyur mibbinyayna — shere letaltolinhu, dachazu lemizga alayyhu. sharginhu vadday aktzinhu.

Amar rav nachman amar shemuel: cheres ketanna — muttar letaltelah bechatzer, aval becharmelit — lo. verav nachman dideh amar: afillu becharmelit, aval birshut harabbim — lo. verava amar: afillu birshut harabbim.

Veazda rava letameh. derava hava kaazel beritka demachoza, ittavvavs mesaneh tina. ata shammaeh, shekal chaspa veka mechappar leh. remo beh rabbanan kala. amar: la missatyay dela gemiri, migmar name magmeri?! illu bechatzer havay mi la hava chazya lechassoye bay mana? hacha name — chazya ledidi.

Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: megufat chavit shennichteta — muttar letaltel beshabbat. tanya name hachi: megufa shennichteta — hi ushevareha muttar letaltelah beshabbat. velo yispot mimmenna shever lechassot bah et hakkeli velismoch bah kare hammitta. veim zerakah baashpa — asur.
Matkif la rav pappa: ella meatta, zarek leh liglimeh hachi name deasur?! ella amar rav pappa:

a: Im zerakah mibbeod yom leashpa — asura.

Amar bar hamedure amar shemuel: kerumiyyot shel machtzelet — muttar letaltelan beshabbat. may tama? amar rava, bar hamedure asbera li: machtzelet gufa lemay chazya — lechassoye ba afra, hane name chazyayn lechassoye behu tinnufa.
Amar rabbi zera amar rav: sheyare peruzemayot — asur letaltelan beshabbat. amar abbaye: bematlaniyyot sheen bahen shalosh al shalosh, dela chazyayn la laaniyyim vela laashirim.

Tanu rabbanan: shivre tannur yashan hare hen kechol hakkelim hannittalin bechatzer, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer: en nittalin. heid rabbi yose mishshum rabbi eliezer ben yaakov al shivre tannur yashan shennittalin bashshabbat, veal kissuyo sheeno tzarich bet yad.
Bemay kamippalgi? amar abbaye: beosin meen melacha, veen osin meen melachtan kamippalgi. veazda rabbi yehuda letameh, verabbi meir letameh.
Matkif la rava: i hachi, addemippalgi beshivre tannur, lippalgu beshivre chelim bealma?

Ella amar rava: beshivre dehay tannur kamippalgi. ditnan: netano al pi habbor o al pi haddut venatan sham even, rabbi yehuda omer: im massik millematta vehu nissok millemala — tame, veim lav — tahor. vachachamim omrim: hoil vehussak mikkol makom — tame.

Uvemay kamippalgi — behay kera: "tannur vechirayim yuttatz temeim hem utemeim yihyu lachem", rabbi yehuda savar: mechussar netitza — tame, sheen mechussar netitza — tahor. verabbanan savri: "temeim yihyu lachem" — mikkol makom.
Verabbanan name, hachtiv: "yuttatz"? hahu leiddach gisa, desalka datach amena: kevan dechabbereh beara — kegufa deara dame, ka mashma lan.
Veiddach name, hachtiv: "temeim yihyu lachem"! hahi, kidrav yehuda amar shemuel. deamar rav yehuda amar shemuel: machaloket behessek rishon, aval behessek sheni, afillu taluy betzavvar gamal.
Amar ulla: vehessek rishon lerabbanan, afillu taluy betzavvar gamal.
Matkef la rav ashe: i hachi, addemippalgi beshivre tannur, lippalgu betannur gufe. hasheta tannur gufe lerabbi yehuda la have mana, shevarav mibbaya?!

Ella amar rav ashe: leolam kedaamaran meikkara uveose maase tafka, verabbi meir lidvarav derabbi yehuda kaamar: ledidi afillu beosin meen melacha, ella ledidach, odi li miha dichhay gavvna melachto hu!
Verabbi yehuda: la dame, hatam — hesseko mibbifnim, hacha — hesseko mibbachutz. hatam — meummad, hacha — lav meummad.

Heid rabbi yose mishshum rabbi eliezer ben yaakov al shivre tannur yashan shennittalin bashshabbat, veal kissuyo sheeno tzarich bet yad. amar ravina: keman metaltelinan haiddana kissuy detannure demata machseya deen lahem bet achiza? keman — kerabbi eliezer ben yaakov.
Mishna haeven shebbekeruya, im memallein bah veenah nofelet — memallein bah, veim lav — en memallein bah.
b: Zemora shehi keshura battafiach — memallein bah beshabbat.
Pekak hachallon, rabbi eliezer omer: bizman shehu kashur vetaluy — pokkin bo, veim lav — en pokkin bo. vachachamim omrim: ben kach uven kach — pokkin bo.

Gemara tenan hatam: even sheal pi hechavit — mattah al tziddah, vehi nofelet. amar rabba amar rabbi amme amar rabbi yochanan: lo shanu ella beshocheach, aval bemanniach — naasa basis ledavar haasur. verav yosef amar rabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan: lo shanu ella beshocheach, aval bemanniach — naasa kissuy lechavit.
Amar rabba, motvinan ashshematin: haeven shebbekeruya im memallein bah veenah nofelet — memallein bah! vela hi. hatam, kevan dehaddeka — shavveya dofen.
Amar rav yosef, umotvinan ashshematin: im lav — en memallein bah! vela hi. hatam, kevan dela haddeka — battole battela.
Bemay kamippalgi? mar savar baenan maase, umar savar la baenan maase.

Veazdu letamayyhu, dechi ata rav dimi amar rabbi chanina, veamri la amar rabbi zera amar rabbi chanina: paam achat halach rabbi lemakom echad umatza nidbach shel avanim, veamar letalmidav: tzeu vechashshevu kede shenneshev alehen lemachar, velo hitzrichan rabbi lemaase.
Rabbi yochanan amar: hitzrichan rabbi lemaase. may amar lehu? rabbi amme amar: "tzeu velammedum" amar lehu. rabbi assi amar: "tzeu veshafshefum" amar lehu.

Ittemar, rabbi yose ben shaul amar: sevar shel korot hava. verabbi yochanan ben shaul amar: gashosh shel sefina hava. man daamar gashosh — kol shekken sevar, uman deamar sevar — aval gashosh kafed aleh.
Zemora shehi keshura kulei. keshura — in, lo keshura — la. lema matnitin dela kerabban shimon ben gamliel.
Detanya: chariyyot shel dekel sheggedaran leetzim venimlach alehen lishiva — tzarich likshor. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: en tzarich likshor.

Amar rav sheshet: afillu tema rabban shimon ben gamliel, hacha bemay askinan — bimchubberet beibbeha. i hachi, ka mishtammesh bimchubbar lakkarka! lematta mishshelosha. rav ashe amar: afillu tema bitlusha, gezera shemma yiktom.

Pekak hachallon kulei. amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: hakkol modim sheen osin ohel aray battechilla beyom tov, veen tzarich lomar beshabbat. lo nechleku ella lehosif. sherabbi eliezer omer: en mosifin beyom tov, veen tzarich lomar beshabbat. vachachamim omrim: mosifin beshabbat, veen tzarich lomar beyom tov.
Vachachamim omrim: ben kach uven kach pokkin bo. may "ben kach uven kach"? amar rabbi abba amar rav kahana:

a: Ben kashur ben sheeno kashur, vehu shemmetukkan.

Amar leh rabbi yirmeya, velema mar: ben taluy uven sheeno taluy, vehu shekkashur! deamar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: kemachaloket kan, kach machaloket banneger hannigrar. ditnan: neger hannigrar, noalin bo bammikdash, aval lo bimdina. vehammunnach, kan vechan, asur. rabbi yehuda omer: hammunnach bemikdash vehannigrar bammedina.

Vetanya: ezehu neger hannigrar shennoalin bo bammikdash aval lo bimdina? kol shekkashur vetaluy verosho maggia laaretz. rabbi yehuda omer: ze af bammedina muttar. ella ezehu shebbammedina asur — kol sheeno lo kashur vela taluy, veshomto umannicho bekeren zavit.
Veamar rabbi yehoshua bar abba mishshemeh deulla: man tanna neger hannigrar — rabbi eliezer hi!

Amar leh: ana daamari ki hay tanna detanya: kane shehitkino baal habbayit lihyot poteach venoel bo, bizman shekkashur vetaluy bappetach — poteach venoel bo, en kashur vetaluy — en poteach venoel bo. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: metukkan, af al pi sheeno kashur.
Amar rav yehuda bar shilat amar rav assi amar rabbi yochanan: halacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel.
Umi amar rabbi yochanan hachi? vehatnan: kol kissuye hakkelim
b: Sheyyesh lahem bet achiza nittalin bashshabbat. veamar rav yehuda bar shela amar rav assi amar rabbi yochanan: vehu sheyyesh torat keli alehen.

Vechi tema: hacha name deikka torat keli alav, umi bae rabban shimon ben gamliel torat keli alav? vehatanya: chariyyot shel dekel sheggedaran leshem etzim, venimlach alehen lishiva — tzarich lekashsher. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: en tzarich lekashsher.
Rabbi yochanan sevira leh kevoteh bachada ufelig aleh bachada.
Derash rabbi yitzchak nappacha appitcha deresh galuta: halacha kerabbi eliezer. metiv rav amram: umiddivrehem lamadnu sheppokkin umoddin vekoshrin beshabbat!
Amar leh [abbaye]: may dataych — mishshum dekatane setama, neger hannigrar name setama hi. vaafillu hachi — maase rav.

Mishna kol kissuye hakkelim sheyyesh lahem bet achiza — nittalin bashshabbat. amar rabbi yose: bamme devarim amurim — bechissuy karkaot, aval bechissuy hakkelim — ben kach uven kach nittalin bashshabbat.

Gemara amar rav yehuda bar shela amar rabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan: vehu sheyyesh torat keli alehen. dechulle alma kissuy karkaot, im yesh lahen bet achiza — in, i la — la. kissuy hakkelim, af al gav deen lahem bet achiza.
Ki peligi bechelim dechabberinhu beara. mar savar gazrinan, umar savar la gazrinan.
Lishshana acharina: ki peligi bechissuy tannur, mar medamme leh lechissuy karka, umar medamme leh lechissuy kelim.
Haderan alach kol hakkelim
Mishna mefannin afillu arba vechamesh kuppot shel teven veshel tevua mippene haorchim, umippene bittul bet hammidrash. aval lo et haotzar.
Mefannin teruma tehora, udemay, umaaser rishon shennitlah terumato, umaaser sheni vehekdesh shennifdu, vehattormos hayyavesh mippene shehu maachol leizzim.

Aval lo et hattevel, velo et maaser [rishon] shello nittela terumato, velo et maaser sheni vehekdesh shello nifdu, velo et halluf, vela et hachardal. rabbi shimon ben gamliel mattir balluf, mippene shehu maachal orvin.
Chavile kash vachavile etzim vachavile zeradim, im hitkinan lemaachal behema — metaltelin otan. veim lav — en metaltelin otan.
Gemara hasheta chamesh mefannin, arba mibbaya?!
Amar rav chisda: arba mechamesh, (ikka deamri: arba meotzar katan) vechamesh meotzar gadol.
Umay "aval lo et haotzar" — shello yatchil baotzar techilla, umanni — rabbi yehuda hi, deit leh muketze.
Ushemuel amar: arba vechamesh

a: Kidamri inashe, vei bae afillu tuva name mefannin. umay "aval lo et haotzar" — shello yigmor kullo, dilma ate leashvoye gummot. aval atchole matchil. umanni — rabbi shimon hi, delet leh muketze.
Tanu rabbanan: en matchilin baotzar techilla, aval ose bo shevil kede sheyyikkanes veyetze. ose bo shevil?! veha amrat en matchilin! hachi kaamar: ose bo shevil beraglav bichnisato uvitziato.

Tanu rabbanan: tevua tzevura, bizman shehitchil bah meerev shabbat — muttar lehistappek mimmenna beshabbat, veim lav — asur lehistappek mimmenna beshabbat, divre rabbi shimon. rabbi acha mattir: kelappe leyay! ella ema: divre rabbi acha, verabbi shimon mattir.
Tana: kamma shiur tevua tzevura — letech. bea minneh rav nechumi bar zecharya meabbaye: shiur tevua tzevura bechamma? amar leh hare amru: shiur tevua tzevura — letech.
Ibbaya lehu: hane arba vechamesh kuppot dekaamar, bearba vechamesh kuppot — in, tefe — la, alma lemaote behillucha adif, o dilma lemaote massoy adif.

Ta shema, detane chada: mefannin afillu arba vechamesh kuppot shel kadde shemen veshel kadde yayin. vetanya iddach: beeser uvachamesh esre. may lav beha kamippalgi, demar savar maote behillucha adif, umar savar maote bemassoy adif?

La, dechulle alma maote behillucha adif, umi savrat "beeser uvachamesh esre" akkuppot kae? akkaddin kae, vela kashya: ha demishtakli chad chad bekuppa, veha demishtakli tere tere, veha demishtakli telata telata — uvidkure deharpanya.

Ibbaya lehu: hane arba vechamesh dekaamar, af al gav deit leh orchin tuva, o dilma hakkol lefi haorchin? veim timtze lomar hakkol lefi haorchin, chad gavra mefanne lechullehu, o dilma gavra gavra mefanne lenafsheh?

Ta shema, deamar rabba amar rabbi chiyyay: paam achat halach rabbi lemakom echad, veraa makom dachuk lattalmidim, veyatza lassade umatza sade melea omarim, veimmer rabbi kol hassade kullah. (shema minna: hakkol lefi haorchin.)

Verav yosef amar rabbi hoshaya: paam achat halach rabbi chiyyay lemakom echad veraa makom dachuk lattalmidim, veyatza lassade umatza sade melea omarim, veimmer rabbi chiyyay kol hassade kullah. shema minna: hakkol lefi haorchin.
Vaadayin tibbee lach: chad gavra mefanne (leh) lechullehu, o dilma kol gavra vegavra mefanne lenafsheh?
Ta shema: veimmer rabbi. uletamaych, rabbi bedinfasheha immer?! ella tzivva veimmer, uleolam kol chad vechad mefanne lenafsheh.

Mippene haorchin vechulei. amar rabbi yochanan: gedola hachenasat orchin kehashekamat bet hammidrash, dekatane: "mippene haorchin umippene bittul bet hammidrash". verav dimi minnehardea amar: yoter mehashekamat bet hammidrash, dekatane "mippene haorchin", vahadar "umippene bittul bet hammidrash". amar rav yehuda amar rav: gedola hachenasat orchin mehakebalat pene shechina, dichtiv: "vayyomar Adonai im na matzati chen beenecha al na taavor vegomer". amar rabbi elazar: bo uree shello kemiddat hakkadosh baruch hu middat basar vadam. middat basar vedam, en katan yachol lomar laggadol "hameten ad sheavo etzlecha", veillu behakkadosh baruch hu ketiv "vayyomar Adonai im na matzati vegomer".

Amar rav yehuda bar shela amar rabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan: shishsha devarim adam ochel perotehen baolam hazze vehakkeren kayyemet lo laolam habba, veellu hen: hachenasat orchin, uvikkur cholim, veiyyun tefilla, vehashekamat bet hammidrash, vehamegaddel banav letalmud tora, vehaddan et chavero lechaf zechut.

Ini?! veha anan tenan: ellu devarim sheadam ose otam veochel perotehen baolam hazze, vehakkeren kayyemet lo laolam habba, veellu hen: kibbud av vaem, ugemilut chasadim, vahavaat shalom shebben adam lachavero, vetalmud tora keneged kullam [hane — in, midde acharina — la]!
b: Hane name, (bigmilut chasadim shayychi. lishshana acharina: hane) behane shayychi.

Tanu rabbanan: haddan chavero lechaf zechut — danin oto lizchut. umaase beadam echad sheyyarad miggalil haelyon veniskar etzel baal habbayit echad baddarom shalosh shanim. erev yom hakkippurim amar lo: ten li sechari, veelech veazun et ishti uvanay. amar lo: en li maot. amar lo: ten li perot. amar lo: en li. ten li karka — en li. ten li behema — en li. ten li karim uchesatot — en li. hifshil kelav laachorav, vehalach leveto befache nefesh.

Leachar haregel natal baal habbayit secharo beyado, veimmo massoy shelosha chamorim, echad shel maachol, veechad shel mishte, veechad shel mine megadim, vehalach lo leveto. achar sheachlu veshatu natan lo secharo.

Amar lo: beshaa sheamarta li "ten li sechari" veamarti "en li maot", bamme chashadtani? amarti: shemma perakmatya bezol nizdammena lecha, velakachta bahen. uveshaa sheamarta li "ten li behema", veamarti "en li behema", bamme chashadtani? amarti: shemma musekeret beyad acherim. beshaa sheamarta li "ten li karka", veamarti lecha "en li karka", bamme chashadtani? amarti: shemma muchekeret beyad acherim hi. uveshaa sheamarti lecha "en li perot" bamme chashadtani? amarti: shemma enan meussarot. uveshaa sheamarti lecha "en li karim uchesatot" bamme chashadtani? amarti: shemma hikdish kol nechasav lashshamayim.

Amar lo: haavoda! kach haya. hiddarti kol nechasay bishvil hurekanos beni shello asak battora. ucheshebbati etzel chaveray baddarom hittiru li kol nedaray. veatta, keshem sheddantani lizchut, hammakom yadin otcha lizchut.
Tanu rabbanan: maase bechasid echad sheppada riva achat bat yisrael, velammalon hishkivah tachat margelotav. lemachar yarad vetaval veshana letalmidav.
Veamar lahen: beshaa shehishkavtiha tachat margelotay, bamme chashadtuni? amarnu: shemma yesh banu talmid sheeno baduk lerabbi.

Beshaa sheyyaradti vetavalti, bamme chashadtuni? amarnu: shemma mippene torach hadderech era keri lerabbi. amar lahem: haavoda! kach haya. veattem, keshem sheddantuni lechaf zechut, hammakom yadin etchem lechaf zechut.
Tanu rabbanan: paam achat hutzerach davar echad letalmide chachamim etzel matronita achat shekkol gedole romi metzuyin etzlah. amru: mi yelech? amar lahem rabbi yehoshua: ani elech.
Halach rabbi yehoshua vetalmidav. kevan shehiggia lefetach betah, chalatz tefillav berichuk arba ammot, venichnas venaal haddelet bifnehen. achar sheyyatza, yarad vetaval veshana letalmidav.
Veamar lahen: beshaa shechalatzti tefillin, bamme chashadtuni? amarnu: kesavur rabbi, lo yikkansu divre kedushsha bimkom tumea.
Beshaa shennaalti, bamme chashadtuni? amarnu: shemma devar malchut yesh beno levenah.

Beshaa sheyyaradti vetavalti bamme chashadtuni, amarnu: shemma nitteza tzinnora mippiha al begadav shel rabbi. amar lahem: haavoda! kach haya. veattem, keshem sheddantuni lizchut, hammakom yadin etchem lizchut.
Mefannin teruma tehora vechulei. peshita! la tzericha, demannecha beyad yisrael. mahu detema: kevan dela chazya leh — asur, ka mashma lan kevan dechazya lechohen — shappir dame.

Udemay vechulei. demay, ha la chaze leh! kevan dei bae mafkar leh lenichseh vehave ani, vachaze leh, hasheta name chaze leh. ditnan: maachilin et haaniyyim demay veet haachsanya demay. veamar rav huna: tana, bet shammay omrim: en maachilin et haaniyyim demay veet haachsanya demay. uvet hillel omrim: maachilin et haaniyyim demay veet haachsanya demay.
Umaaser rishon shennittela terumato vechulei. peshita! la tzericha shehikdimo beshibbolim, venittela hemennu terumat maaser, velo nittela hemennu teruma gedola.

Vechi ha deamar rabbi avahu amar resh lakish: maaser rishon shehikdimo beshibbolin — patur mitteruma gedola, shenneemar: "vaharemotem mimmennu terumat Adonai maaser min hammaaser". maaser min hammaaser amarti lecha, velo teruma gedola uterumat maaser min hammaaser.
Amar leh rav pappa leabbaye: i hachi, afillu hikdimo bichri name lippetar! amar leh: alecha amar kera: "mikkol mattenotechem tarimu vegomer".
Uma raita? hay iddegan, vehay la iddegan.
Umaaser sheni vechulei. peshita! la tzericha shennatan et hakkeren velo natan et hachomesh. ha ka mashma lan deen chomesh meakkev.
Vehattormos hayyavesh kulei. davvka yavesh, aval lach — la. may tama? kevan demarir la achla.

a: Aval lo et hattevel vechulei. peshita! la tzericha betevel tavul midderabbanan, shezzerao beatzitz sheeno nakuv.

Velo maaser rishon vechulei. peshita! la tzericha, shehikdimo bichri, shennatal mimmennu maaser velo nittela mimmennu teruma gedola. mahu detema kedaamar leh rav pappa leabbaye, ka mashma lan kidshanni leh abbaye.

Velo et maaser sheni vechulei. peshita! la tzericha denifdu velo nifdu kehilchatan. maaser — sheppedao al gabbe asimon, derachamana amar "vetzarta hakkesef beyadcha", davar sheyyesh bo tzura. hekdesh — shechillelo al gabbe karka, derachamana amar "venatan hakkesef vekam lo".

Velo et halluf. tanu rabbanan: metaltelin et hechatzav mippene shehu maachol litzvayim, veet hachardal mippene shehu maachol leyonim. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: af metaltelin shivre zechuchit mippene shehu maachol lenaamiyyot.
Amar leh rabbi natan: ella meatta chavile zemorot yetaltelu mippene shehu maachol lefilin! verabban shimon ben gamliel: naamiyyot — shechichi, pilin — la shechichi.

Amar ammemar: vehu deit leh naamiyyot. amar rav ashe leammemar: ella dekaamar leh rabbi natan lerabban shimon ben gamliel chavile zemorot yetaltel mippene shehu maachol lefilin, i it leh pilin — ammay la? ella rauy, hacha name rauy.
Amar abbaye: rabban shimon ben gamliel verabbi shimon verabbi yishmael verabbi akiva kullehu sevira lehu kol yisrael bene melachim hem.
Rabban shimon ben gamliel — ha daamaran.
Rabbi shimon — ditnan: bene melachim sachin al gabbe makkotehen shemen vevred, shekken darkan shel bene melachim lasuch bachol. rabbi shimon omer: kol yisrael bene melachim hem.

Rabbi yishmael verabbi akiva — detanya: hare shehayu noshin bo elef mane velavush itztela bat mea mane — mafshitin oto, umalbishin oto itztela haruya lo. tana mishshum rabbi yishmael umishshum rabbi akiva: kol yisrael reuyin leotah itztela.

Chavile kash vachavile kulei. tanu rabbanan: chavile kash vachavile etzim vachavile zeradim, im hitkinan lemaachal behema — metaltelin otan, veim lav — en metaltelin otan. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: chavilin hannittalin beyad achat — muttar letaltelan, bishte yadayim — asur letaltelan.
Chavile sia ezov vekoranit, hichnisan leetzim — en mistappek mehen beshabbat, lemaachal behema — mistappek mehen beshabbat.

Vekotem bayyad veochel, uvilvad shello yiktom bichli. umolel veochel, uvilvad shello yimlol bichli harebe, divre rabbi yehuda. vachachamim omrim: molel berashe etzbeotav veochel, uvilvad shello yimlol beyado harebe kederech shehu ose bachol.
Vechen beammita vechen befegam vechen bishar mine tavlin. may ammita? "ninya". sia? amar rav yehuda: (sia) "tzitri". ezov — "avrata". koranit — "koranita" shemah.
Veha hahu daamar lehu: man bae koranita? veishtechach chashe! ella: sia tzitri, ezov avrata, koranita chashe.
Ittemar: basar maliach muttar letaltelo beshabbat. basar tafel, rav huna amar: muttar letaltelo, rav chisda amar: asur letaltelo.
Rav huna amar muttar letaltelo? veha rav huna talmid derav hava, verav kerabbi yehuda sevira leh deit leh muketze?!
Bemuketze laachila — savar la kerabbi yehuda, bemuketze letaltel — savar la kerabbi shimon.

Rav chisda amar asur letaltelo. veha rav yitzchak bar amme ikkela leve rav chisda, vachaza hahu bar avoza dahavo ka metaltelu leh mishshimsha letulla, veamar rav chisda: chesron kis ka chazenan hacha! shane bar avoza, dachaze leumetza.
Tanu rabbanan: dag maliach — muttar letaltelo, dag tafel — asur letaltelo. basar, ben tafel uven maliach — muttar letaltelo, usetama kerabbi shimon.
Tanu rabbanan: metaltelin et haatzamot mippene shehu maachol lichlavim.
b: Basar tafuach — mippene shehu maachol lechayya, mayim megullin — mippene shehen reuyin lechatul. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: kol atzman asur leshahotan mippene hassakkana.
Mishna kofin et hassal lifne haefrochim kede sheyyaalu veyerdu. tarnegolet shebbarcha — dochin otah ad shettikkanes.
Medaddin agalin useyaychin. ishsha medadda et benah. amar rabbi yehuda: ematay — bizman shehu notel achat umanniach achat, aval im haya gorer — asur.
Gemara amar rav yehuda amar rav: behema shennafla leammat hammayim — mevi karim uchesatot umanniach tachteha, veim alta — alta.
Metivi: behema shennafla leammat hammayim — ose lah parnasa bimkomah bishvil shello tamut. parnasa — in, karim uchesatot — la!
La kashya, ha — deefshar befarnasa, ha — dei efshar befarnasa. efshar befarnasa — in, vei la — mevi karim uchesatot umanniach tachteha.
Veha ka mevattel keli mehecheno! savar mevattel keli mehecheno derabbanan, tzaar baale chayyim deorayyta, veate deorayyta vedache derabbanan.
Tarnegolet shebbarcha vechulei. dochin — in, medaddin — la. tenena leha, detanu rabbanan: medaddin behema chayya vaof bechatzer, aval lo et hattarnegolet.
Tarnegolet may tama la? amar abbaye: mishshum demakpeya nafshah.

Tane chada: medaddin behema vechayya vaof bechatzer aval lo birshut harabbim, vehaishsha medadda et benah birshut harabbim, veen tzarich lomar bechatzer. vetanya iddach: en okrin behema vechayya vaof bechatzer, aval dochin bahen sheyyikkansu.
Ha gufa kashya: amrat en okrin, aval daddoye — medaddinan, hadar amrat: dochin in, medaddin — la! amar abbaye: sefa atan letarnegolet.
Amar abbaye: hay man deshachet tarnegolta — lichbeshinhu lechareh beara, i name nedel lehu medel, dedilma mannach lehu letufereh beara, veakar lehu lesimanim.

Mishna en meyalledin et habbehema beyom tov, aval mesaadin. umeyalledin et haishsha beshabbat, vekorin lah chachama mimmakom lemakom, umechallelin aleha et hashshabbat, vekoshrin et hattibbur. rabbi yose omer: af chotchin. vechol tzorche milla osin beshabbat.
Gemara ketzad mesaadin? rav yehuda amar: ochez et havvalad shello yippol laaretz, rav nachman amar: dochek babbasar kede sheyyetze havvalad.
Tanya kevoteh derav yehuda: ketzad mesaadin? ochazin et havvalad shello yippol laaretz, venofeach lo bechotmo, venoten lo dad letoch piv kede sheyyinak.

Amar rabban shimon ben gamliel: merachamin hayinu al behema tehora beyom tov. hechi aved? amar abbaye: mevi bul shel melach umanniach lah betoch harechem, kede shettizkor tzaarah uterachem alav. umezallefin me shilya al gabbe valad, kede shettariach recho uterachem alav. vedavka tehora, aval temea — la.
May tama? temea la merachaka velada, vei merachaka velada — la mekarva.
Meyalledin et haishsha vechulei. mikkede tena leh: meyalledin et haishsha vekorin lah chachama mimmakom lemakom, "umechallelin aleha et hashshabbat" leetoye may?

Leetoye ha detanu rabbanan: im hayta tzericha lener — chavertah madleket lah et hanner. veim hayta tzericha leshemen — chavertah mevia lah shemen bayyad, veim eno sofek bayyad — mevia bisarah, veim eno sofek bisarah — mevia lah bichli.

Amar mar: im hayta tzericha lener — chavertah madleket lah et hanner. peshita! la tzericha besuma, mahu detema: kevan dela chazya — asir, ka mashma lan iyyattove miyyatteva data, savra: i ikka midde — chazya chavirtay veavda li.
Im hayta tzericha leshemen vechulei. tippok leh mishshum sechita!
Rabba verav yosef deamri tarvavyyhu: en sechita besear. rav ashe amar: afillu tema yesh sechita besear, mevia lah bichli derech searah, dechamma deefshar leshannoye — meshanninan.
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: chayya kol zeman shehakkever patuach, ben amra "tzericha ani", ben lo amra "tzericha ani" — mechallelin aleha et hashshabbat.
Nistam hakkever, ben amra

a: "Tzericha ani", ben lo amra "tzericha ani" — en mechallelin aleha et hashshabbat.

Rav ashe matne hachi. mar zutera matne hachi: amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: chayya kol zeman shehakkever patuach, ben amra "tzericha ani", uven amra "en tzericha ani" — mechallelin aleha et hashshabbat. nistam hakkever, amra "tzericha ani" — mechallelin aleha et hashshabbat. lo amra "tzericha ani" — en mechallelin aleha et hashshabbat.
Amar leh ravina lemarimar: mar zutera matne lekulla, verav ashe matne lechumera, hilcheta keman? amar leh: halacha kemar zutera, safek nefashot lehakel.

Meematay petichat hakkever? amar abbaye: mishshaa shetteshev al hammashber. rav huna bereh derav yehoshua amar: mishshaa shehaddam shotet veyored, veamri la mishshaa shechavroteha nosot otah baagappeha.
Ad matay petichat hakkever? amar abbaye: shelosha yamim. rava amar mishshemeh derav yehuda: shiva, veamri la: sheloshim.

Amri nehardae: chayya shelosha shiva usheloshim. shelosha, ben amra "tzericha ani", uven amra "lo tzericha ani" — mechallelin aleha et hashshabbat. shiva, amra "tzericha ani" — mechallelin aleha et hashshabbat, amra "lo tzericha ani" — en mechallelin aleha et hashshabbat. sheloshim, afillu amra "tzericha ani" — en mechallelin aleha et hashshabbat, aval osin al yede armay.
Kidrav ulla bereh derav illay, deamar: kol tzorche chole naasin al yede armay beshabbat, vechidrav hamenuna, deamar rav hamenuna: davar sheen bo sakkana — omer legoy veose.
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: lechayya sheloshim yom. lemay hilcheta? amri nehardae: litvila.

Amar rava: la amaran ella sheen balah immah, aval balah immah — balah mechammema. ki ha divratte derav chisda tevala bego telatin yomin shello bifne balah veitzteniat, veamteyuha learsa batreh derava lefumebdita.

Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: osin medura lechayya beshabbat bimot haggeshamim. sevur minna lechayya — in, lachole — la, bimot haggeshamim — in, bimot hachamma — la. vela hi, la shena chayya vela shena chole, la shena bimot haggeshamim vela shena bimot hachamma. middeittemar, amar rav chiyyay bar avin amar shemuel: hikkiz dam venitztannen — osin lo medura afillu bitkufat tammuz.
Shemuel tzallachu leh tachtaka deshaga, rav yehuda tzallachu leh patura deyona, lerabba tzallachu leh sharshifa.
Vaamar leh abbaye lerabba: veha kaavar mar mishshum "bal tashchit"! amar leh: "bal tashchit" degufay adif li.
Amar rav yehuda amar rav: leolam yimkor adam korot beto veyikkach minalim leraglav. hikkiz dam veen lo ma yochal — yimkor minalim shebberaglav veyaspik mehen tzorche seuda.
May tzorche seuda? rav amar: basar, ushemuel amar: yayin. rav amar: basar — nafsha chalaf nafsha. ushemuel amar: yayin — summaka chalaf summaka.
(Siman "shennimsar").

Shemuel beyoma daavad milleta, avdi leh tavshila ditchale. rabbi yochanan shate ad denafek tihya meunneh. verav nachman shate ad dekafe techaleh. rav yosef shate ad denafek merivda dechusilta. rava mehaddar achamra bar telata tarfe.
Amar lehu rav nachman bar yitzchak lerabbanan: bematuta minnayychu, beyoma dehakkaza emaru levetayychu: nachman ikkela legabban.

Vechullehu iarome asiri, bar mehay orma dishre: man deaved milleta vela efshar leh, lishkol zuza macha velezil leshav chanvata, ad detaem shiur reviata. vei la — lechol shav tamre ukkamata, veleshuf mishcha betzideh, venigne beshimsha.
Avlet ashkecheh lishmuel degane beshimsha. amar leh: chakkima dihudae, bisha mi have tava?! amar leh: yoma dehakkaza hu.
Vela hi, ella ikka yoma dimalle be shimsha bechulla shatta — yoma denafla beh tekufat tammuz. vesavar: la eygalle leh.
(Hekel beruach tama shaha — siman) rav ushemuel deamri tarvayyhu: kol hammakkel bisudat hakkazat dam — mekillin lo mezonotav min hashshamayim, veomrim: hu al chayyav lo chas, ani achus alav?!
Rav ushemuel deamri tarvayyhu: hay man deaved milleta — la littiv hecha dichrich zika, dilma shafe leh ummana umokem leh arvieta, veate zika veshaef minneh, veate lide sakkana.
Shemuel hava regil deaved milleta beveta deshav livne vearcha. yoma chada avad, veargish benafsheh. bedak vachasar chad archa.
Rav ushemuel deamri tarvayyhu: hay man deaved milleta — litom midde vahadar lippok. dei la taem midde, i paga beshachva — yarki appeh. i paga beman dekatel nafsha — mayet. i paga
b: Bedavar acher — kashe ledavar acher.

Rav ushemuel deamri tarvayyhu: hay man deaved milleta — lishhe pureta vahadar lekum — deamar mar: chamishsha devarim kerovin lemita yoter min hachayyim, veellu hen: achal veamad, shata veamad, yashen veamad, hikkiz dam veamad, shimmesh mittato veamad.
Amar shemuel: puresa didma — kol telatin yomin. uven happerakim — yemaet, uven happerakim yachzor vimaet.

Veamar shemuel: puresa didma — chad beshabbeta, arbaa, umaale shabbeta, aval sheni vachamishi — la. deamar mar: mi sheyyesh lo zechut avot yakkiz dam besheni uvachamishi, shebbet din shel mala veshel matta shavin keechad.
Bitlata beshabbeta may tama la? mishshum dekayyma leh madim bezavevy. maale shabbeta name kayyma bezavevy! kevan dedashu beh rabbim — "shomer petaim Adonai".
Amar shemuel: arba dehu arba, arba dehu arbesar, arba dehu esrim vearbea, arba delekka arba batreh — sakkanta.

Rosh chodesh vesheni lo — chulesha. shelishi lo — sakkana. maale yoma tava — chulesha. maale yoma daatzarta — sakkanta. ugezaru rabbanan akkullehu maale yoma tava mishshum yoma (tava) daatzarta, denafek beh zika ushemeh "tavoach", dei la kabbilu yisrael tora — hava tavach lehu levisrayyhu velidmayyhu.
Amar shemuel: achal chitta vehikkiz dam — lo hikkiz ella leotah chitta. vehane mille lirfua, aval akkole — mekel.
Hammakkiz dam, shetiyyay — lealtar. achila — ad chatzi mil.
Ibbaya lehu: shetiyyay lealtar mealle, aval batar hachi kashe, o dilma la kashe vela mealle? teku.
Ibbaya lehu: achila ad chatzi mil hu dekamalle, ha batar hachi umikkamme hachi — kashe, o dilma la kashe vela mealle? teku.
Machriz rav: mea kare bezuza, mea reshe bezuza, mea sefame vela chelum. amar rav yosef: ki havenan be rav huna, yoma dimfaggeri beh rabbanan, amri: haiddana yoma disfame hu, vela yadana may kaamri.

Vekoshrin hattabbur. tanu rabbanan: koshrin hattabbur. rabbi yose omer: af chotchin. vetomnin hashshilya kede sheyyecham havvalad. amar rabban shimon ben gamliel: benot melachim — tomnot bisfalim shel shemen, benot ashirim — bisfogim shel tzemer, benot aniyyim bemochin.
Amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu amar rav: halacha kerabbi yose.
Veamar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu amar rav: modim chachamim lerabbi yose betabbur shel shene tinokot, shechotchin. may tama? dimnattechi ahadade.

Veamar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu amar rav: kol haamur befarashat tochacha osin lechayya beshabbat. shenneemar: "umoldotayich beyom hulledet otach lo chorat shorech uvemayim lo ruchatzt lemishi vehomleach lo humlachat vehochtel lo chuttalt".

"Umoldotayich beyom hulledet" — mikkan shemyaylledim et havvalad beshabbat. "lo chorat shorech" — mikkan shechotchin hattabbur beshabbat. "uvemayim lo ruchatzt lemishi" — mikkan sherochatzin havvalad beshabbat. "vehomleach lo humlachat" — mikkan shemmolchin havvalad beshabbat. "vehochtel lo chuttalt" — mikkan shemmelappefin havvalad beshabbat.
Haderan alach mefannin

a: Mishna rabbi eliezer omer: im lo hevi keli meerev shabbat — mevio beshabbat megulle, uvassakkana mechassehu al pi edim.
Veod amar rabbi eliezer: kortim etzim laasot pechamin laasot (keli) barzel.
Kelal amar rabbi akiva: kol melacha sheefshar laasotah meerev shabbat — enah docha et hashshabbat, umila shei efshar laasotah meerev shabbat docha et hashshabbat.

Gemara ibbaya lehu: tama derabbi eliezer mishshum chabbove mitzva, o dilma mishshum chashada. lemay nafka minna? leetoye mechusse al pi edim. i amrat mishshum chabbove mitzva, megulle — in, mechusse — la. ella i amrat mishshum chashada — afillu mechusse, shappir dame. may?

Ittemar amar rabbi levi: lo amarah rabbi eliezer ella lechabbove mitzva. tanya name hachi: mevio megulle veen mevio mechusse, divre rabbi eliezer. amar rav ashe: matnitin name dayka, dekatane: uvishat hassakkana mechassehu al pi edim, besakkana — in, shello besakkana — la, shema minna mishshum chabbove mitzva. shema minna.
Tanya iddach: mevio megulle veen mevio mechusse, divre rabbi eliezer, rabbi yehuda omer mishshum rabbi eliezer: nohagin hayu bishat hassakkana shehayu meviin mechusse al pi edim.
Ibbaya lehu, edim dekaamar: ihu vechad, o dilma: hu utere.
Ta shema: uvassakkana mechassehu al pi edim. i amrat bishlama hu utere — shappir, ella i amrat hu vechad, may "edim"? sheruyim lehaid bimkom acher.
Veod amar rabbi eliezer, tanu rabbanan: bimkomo shel rabbi eliezer hayu kortin etzim laasot pechamin laasot barzel beshabbat, bimkomo shel rabbi yose haggelili hayu ochlin besar of bechalav.

Levi ikkela leve yosef rishba. karivu leh resha detauosa bachalava, la achal. ki ata lekammeh derabbi amar leh: ammay la teshammetinhu? amar leh: atreh derabbi yehuda ben betira hava, veamena: dilma derash lehu kerabbi yose haggelili.

Ditnan, rabbi yose haggelili omer: neemar "lo tochlu chol nevela", veneemar "lo tevashshel gedi bachalev immo". et sheasur mishshum nevela — asur levashshel bechalav. of sheasur mishshum nevela, yachol yehe asur levashshel bechalav — talmud lomar: "bachalev immo", yatza of sheen lo chalev em.

Amar rabbi yitzchak: ir achat hayta beeretz yisrael shehayu osin kerabbi eliezer vehayu metim bizmannan. velo od, ella sheppaam achat gazra malchut harshaa gezera al yisrael al hammila, veal otah hair la gazra.

Tanya, rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: kol mitzva shekkibbelu alehem besimcha, kegon mila, dichtiv: "sas anochi al imratecha kemotze shalal rav" — adayin osin otah besimcha. vechol mitzva shekkibbelu alehem biktata, kegon arayot, dichtiv: "vayyishma moshe et haam boche lemishpechotav", al iske mishpechotav — adayin osin otah biktata, delekka ketubba dela ramu ba tigra.

Tanya, rabbi shimon ben elazar omer: kol mitzva shemmasru yisrael atzman alehem lemita bishat gezerat hammalchut, kegon avoda zara umila — adayin hi muchezeket beyadam, vechol mitzva shello masru yisrael atzman aleha lemita bishat gezerat hammalchut, kegon tefillin — adayin hi meruppa beyadam.
Deamar rabbi yannay: tefillin tzerichin guf naki keelisha baal kenafayim. may hi? amar abbaye: shello yafiach bahem, rava amar: shello yishan bahem.

Veammay karu leh "elisha baal kenafayim"? sheppaam achat gazra malchut harshaa gezera al yisrael shekkol hammanniach tefillin al rosho — yikkeru et mocho, vehaya elisha manniach tefillin veyatza lashshuk, veraahu kasdor echad. ratz millefanav veratz acharav. kevan shehiggia etzlo, netalan merosho vaachazan beyado. amar lo: ma beyadcha? amar lo: kanfe yona. pashat et yado venimtzeu bah kanfe yona. lefichach hayu korin oto "baal kenafayim".

May shena kanfe yona daamar leh, vela amar leh shear ofot? mishshum dedamya keneset yisrael leyona, shenneemar: "kanfe yona nechpa vakkesef veevroteha birakrak charutz" — ma yona zo kenafeha meginnot aleha, af yisrael mitzvot meginnot alehen.
Amar rabbi abba bar rav adda amar rabbi yitzchak: paam achat shachchu velo heviu izmel meerev shabbat, veheviuhu beshabbat [derech gaggot vederech chatzerot]
b: Shello birtzon rabbi eliezer.

Matkif la rav yosef: shello birtzon rabbi eliezer! adderabba, rabbi eliezer hu deshare! vechi tema shello birtzon rabbi eliezer deshare afillu birshut harabbim, ella birtzon rabbanan deasri derech reshut harabbim, vesharu derech gaggot derech chatzerot vekarpefot — umi sharu? vehatanya: keshem sheen meviin oto derech reshut harabbim, kach en meviin oto lo derech gaggot velo derech karpefot velo derech chatzerot!

Ella amar rav ashe: shello birtzon rabbi eliezer umachluketo, ella birtzon rabbi shimon. ditnan, rabbi shimon omer: echad gaggot veechad karpefot veechad chatzerot — kullan reshut echad hen lechelim sheshshavtu betochan, velo lechelim sheshshavtu betoch habbayit.

Bea minneh rabbi zera merabbi assi: mavoy shello nishtattefu bo, mahu letaltel bechullo? mi amrinan kechatzer dame: ma chatzer, af al gav delo ervu — muttar letaltel bechullo, hay name, af al gav delo nishtattefu bo — muttar letaltel bechullo, o dilma: la dame lechatzer, dechatzer it leh arba mechitztzot, hay let leh arba mechitztzot. i name: chatzer it beh dayorin, hay let beh dayorin? shetik vela amar leh vela midde.

Zimnin ashkecheh deyatev veka amar, amar rabbi shimon ben lakish mishshum rabbi yehuda hannasi: paam achat shachchu velo heviu izmel meerev shabbat, veheviuhu beshabbat, vehaya haddavar kashe lachachamim: heach mannichin divre chachamim veosin kerabbi eliezer. chada: derabbi eliezer shammuti hu! veod, yachid verabbim — halacha kerabbim!

Veamar rabbi oshaya: sheelit et rabbi yehuda haggozer veamar li: mavoy shello nishtattefu bo hava, veayytuhu mehay resha lehay resha. amar leh: sevira leh lemar mavoy shello nishtattefu muttar letaltel bechullo? vaamar leh: in. amar leh: veha zimnin beay minnach vela amart li hachi! dilma aggav shitfach rehit lecha gemarach? amar leh: in, aggav shitfa rehit li gemaray.
Ittemar amar rabbi zera amar rav: mavoy shello nishtattefu bo — en metaltelin bo ella bearba ammot.

Amar abbaye: ha milleta amra rabbi zera vela persha ad daata rabba bar avu ufersha. deamar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu amar rav: mavoy shello nishtattefu bo, ervu chatzerot im battim — en metaltelin bo ella bearba ammot. lo ervu chatzerot im battim — muttar letaltel bechullo.
Amar leh rav chanina chozaa lerabba: may shena ki ervu chatzerot im battim — denitteku chatzerot venaasu battim, verav letameh, daamar rav: en hammavoy nittar belechi vekora, ad sheyyehu

a: Battim vachatzerot petuchin letocho, vehacha battim — ikka, chatzerot — lekka. ki lo ervu name, lechzinhu lehane battim keman distimi damu, vachatzerot ikka uvattim — lekka!
Efshar dimvattele leh reshuta dechullehu legabbe chad. sof sof bayit ikka battim lekka!

Efshar demitztzafra vead palga deyoma legabbe chad, mippalgeh deyoma ulefanya legabbe chad. sof sof beiddana deiteh lehay, leteh lehay? ella amar rav ashe: mi garam lachatzerot sheyyeasru — battim, velekka.

Amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: lo lakkol amar rabbi eliezer machshire mitzva dochin et hashshabbat. shehare shete hallechem chovat hayyom hen, velo lemadan rabbi eliezer ella miggezera shava. detanya, rabbi eliezer omer: minnayin lemachshire shete hallechem sheddochin et hashshabbat? — neemra havaa baomer, veneemra havaa bishte hallechem. ma havaa haamura baomer — machshirin dochin et hashshabbat. af havaa haamura bishte hallechem — machshirin dochin et hashshabbat.

Mufene. dei la mufene, ikka lemifrach: ma laomer, shekken im matza katzur — kotzer, tomar bishte hallechem, sheim matza katzur — eno kotzer. laye ippenoye mufene: mikkede ketiv "vahavetem et omer reshit ketzirchem el hakkohen", "miyyom haviachem" lema li? shema minna leafnoye.
Veakkatti: mufene mitztzad echad hu, veshaminan leh lerabbi eliezer deamar mufene mitztzad echad lemedin umeshivin! "taviu" ribbuya hu.

Lemaote may, illema lemaote lulav — vehatanya: lulav vechol machshirav dochin et hashshabbat, divre rabbi eliezer. veella lemaote sukka — vehatanya: sukka vechol machshireha dochin et hashshabbat, divre rabbi eliezer. veella lemaote matztza — vehatanya: matztza vechol machshireha dochin et hashshabbat, divre rabbi eliezer. veella lemaote shofar — vehatanya: shofar vechol machshirav dochin et hashshabbat, divre rabbi eliezer!
Amar rav adda bar ahava: lemaote tzitzit letallito umezuza lefitcho. tanya name hachi: veshavin sheim tziyyetz tallito veasa mezuza lefitcho shehu chayyayv.
May tama? amar rav yosef: lefi sheen kavua lahem zeman. amar leh abbaye: adderabba, middeen kavua lahem zeman,
b: Kol shata veshata zimneh hu? ella amar rav nachman amar rabbi yitzchak, veittema rav huna bereh derav yehoshua: hoil uveyado lehafekiran.

Amar mar: lulav vechol machshirav dochin et hashshabbat divre rabbi eliezer. mena leh lerabbi eliezer ha? i meomer ushete hallechem, shekken tzorech gavoah! ella amar kera: "bayyom". "bayyom" — afillu beshabbat.
Ulemay hilcheta? illema letiltul — itzterich kera lemishre tiltul?! ella lemachshirav.
Verabbanan? hahu mibbee leh bayyom velo ballayla.
Verabbi eliezer, bayyom velo ballayla mena leh? nafka leh miusemachtem lifne Adonai elohechem shivat yamim" — yamim velo lelot.
Verabbanan — itzterich, salka datach amena nelaf shivat yamim missukka: ma lehallan yamim vaafillu lelot, af kan yamim vaafillu lelot — ka mashma lan.
Velichtov rachamana belulav, veneto hanach venelfu minneh! mishshum deikka lemifrach: ma lelulav, shekken taun arbaa minim.
Sukka vechol machshireha dochin et hashshabbat, divre rabbi eliezer. mena leh lerabbi eliezer ha? i meomer ushete hallechem — shekken tzorech gavoah hu. i millulav — shekken taun arbaa minim.
Ella gamar "shivat yamim" millulav: ma lehallan machshirav dochin et hashshabbat, af kan name machshirav dochin et hashshabbat.
Velichtov rachamana besukka, venete hanach veligmeru minneh! mishshum deikka lemifrach: ma lesukka shekken noheget ballelot kevayyamim.

Matztza vechol machshireha dochin et hashshabbat, divre rabbi eliezer. mena leh lerabbi eliezer ha? i meomer ushete hallechem — shekken tzorech gavoah. i millulav — shekken taun arbaa minim. i missukka — shekken noheget ballelot kevayyamim.
Ella gamar "chamishsha asar" "chamishsha asar" mechag hassukkot: ma lehallan, machshireha dochin et hashshabbat, af kan machshireha dochin et hashshabbat.
Velichtov rachamana bematztza, veneto hanach veligmeru minneh! mishshum deikka lemifrach: ma lematztza shekken noheget benashim kevaanashim.

Shofar vechol machshirav dochin et hashshabbat, divre rabbi eliezer. mena leh lerabbi eliezer ha? i meomer ushete hallechem — shekken tzorech gavoah. i millulav — shekken taun arbaa minim. i missukka — shekken noheget ballelot kevayyamim. i mimmatztza — shekken noheget bannashim kevaanashim. ella amar kera: "yom terua yihye lachem". "yom" — afillu beshabbat.
Ulemay? ilema litkia, ha tana deve shemuel "kol melechet avoda lo taasu" — yatzta tekiat shofar urediyyayt happat shehi chachma veenah melacha. ella lemachshirin.
Verabbanan? hahu mibbee leh bayyom velo ballayla. verabbi eliezer bayyom velo ballayla mena leh? nafka leh mibbeyom hakkippurim taaviru shofar bechol artzechem", vegamri mehadade.
