Velichtov rachamana beshofar veleto hanach veligmeru minneh! mittekiat shofar derosh hashshana lekka lemigmar — shekken machneset zichronot shel yisrael laavihen shebbashshamayim. mittekia deyom hakkippurim lekka lemigmar — deamar mar: taku bet din shofar, nifteru avadim levattehem vesadot chozrot levaalehen.
Amar mar: mila vechol machshireha dochin et hashshabbat, divre rabbi eliezer. mena leh lerabbi eliezer ha? i mikkullehu gamar — kidamrinan. veod: ma lehanach

a: Shekken im avar zemannah batla. ella hayeynu tama derabbi eliezer, deamar kera: "uvayyom hashshemini yimmol besar orlato", vaafillu beshabbat.
Velichtov rachamana bemila, veleto hanach veligmeru minneh! mishshum deikka lemifrach: ma lemila shekken nichretu aleha shelosh esre beritot.
Ad kan la peligi rabbanan aleh ella bemachshire mila, aval mila gufa divre hakkol docha shabbat, menalan? amar ulla: halacha. vechen amar rabbi yitzchak halacha.

Metivi: minnayin lefikkuach nefesh sheddoche et hashshabbat? rabbi elazar ben azarya omer: ma mila shehi achat meevarav shel adam docha et hashshabbat — kal vachomer lefikkuach nefesh sheddoche et hashshabbat.

Vei salka datach halacha — kal vachomer mehalacha mi ate? vehatanya, amar lo rabbi elazar ben azarya: akiva, etzem kisora (metamme) halacha, ureviit dam kal vachomer, veen danin kal vachomer mehalacha.
Ella amar rabbi elazar: atya "ot" "ot".
Ella meatta, tefillin dichtiv behu "ot", lidche shabbat!
Ella atya "berit" "berit".
Gadol, dichtiv beh "berit", lidche shabbat!
Ella atya "dorot" "dorot".
Tzitzit, dichtiv beh "dorot", lidche shabbat!
Ella amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: danin "ot" "berit" vedorot" meot" "berit" vedorot" — leappoke hanach, dechad chad hu dichtiv bahen.
Verabbi yochanan amar: amar kera "bayyom". "bayyom", afillu beshabbat.
Amar leh resh lakish lerabbi yochanan: ella meatta mechussere kappara, dichtiv behu "bayyom", hachi name dedachu shabbat?! hahu mibbee leh bayyom velo ballayla.
Hay name, mibbee leh bayyom velo ballayla! hahu mibben shemonat yamim" nafka.
Hay name, mibbeyom tzauoto" nafka!
Af al gav denafka mibbeyom tzauoto", itztericha. salka datach amena: hoil vechas rachamana aleh leetoye bedallut, ballayla name layte, ka mashma lan.
Matkef la ravina: ella meatta, yehe zar kasher bahen, vihe onen kasher bahen! ha ahdereh kera.
Rav acha bar yaakov amar: amar kera: "shemini". "shemini", afillu beshabbat.
Hay "shemini" mibbee leh lemaote shevii! shevii mibben shemonat yamim" nafka.
Veakkatti mibbee leh, chad lemaote shevii, vechad lemaote teshii. dei mechad, hava amena: shevii hu dela meta zimneh, aval mishshemini veelach zimneh hu! ella mechavvavrta kidrabbi yochanan.

Tanya kevoteh derabbi yochanan, udela kerav acha bar yaakov: "shemini yimmol" — afillu beshabbat, uma ani mekayyem "mechalleleha mot yumat" — bishar melachot chutz mimmila. o eno ella afillu mila, uma ani mekayyem "shemini yimmol" — chutz mishshabbat, talmud lomar: "bayyom" — afillu beshabbat.
Amar rava: hay tanna meikkara may ka nicha leh, ulevassof may ka kashya leh?
Hachi kaamar: "shemini yimmol" — afillu beshabbat. uma ani mekayyem "mechalleleha mot yumat" — bishar melachot chutz mimmila, aval mila dachaya,
May tama? — kal vachomer hu: uma tzaraat sheddoche et haavoda,
b: Vaavoda docha et hashshabbat — mila docha otah. shabbat shennidchet mippene haavoda, eno din shettehe mila docha otah?

Umay "o eno" dekaamar — hadar amar: umimmay detzaraat chamura? dilma shabbat chamura, shekken yesh bah onashin veazharot harebe. i name: umimmay mishshum dachamira tzaraat hi, dilma mishshum gavra hu dela chaze. uma ani mekayyem "shemini yimmol" — chutz mishshabbat. talmud lomar: "bayyom" — afillu beshabbat.
Tanu rabbanan: mila docha et hatztzaraat, ben bizmannah ben shello bizmannah. yom tov enah docha ella bizmannah bilvad.
Menahane mille? detanu rabbanan: "yimmol besar orlato", veaf al pi sheyyesh sham baheret, yakotz. uma ani mekayyem "hishshamer benega hatztzaraat" — bishar mekomot chutz mimmila.
O eno ella afillu mila, uma ani mekayyem "yimmol besar orlato" — bizman sheen bah baheret. talmud lomar: "basar", veaf al pi sheyyesh sham baheret.
Amar rava: hay tanna meikkara may nicha leh ulevassof may kashya leh?

Hachi kaamar: "yimmol besar orlato" — veaf al pi sheyyesh [sham] baheret, uma ani mekayyem "hishshamer benega hatztzaraat" — bishar mekomot chutz mimmila. aval mila docha et hatztzaraat, may tama? deatya mikkal vechomer: uma shabbat chamura, mila docha otah, tzaraat lo kol shekken.

Umay "o eno" dekaamar — hadar kaamar: mimmay deshabbat chamira? dilma tzaraat chamira, shekken docha et haavoda, vaavoda docha et hashshabbat! talmud lomar: "basar" — veaf al pi sheyyesh sham baheret.

Lishshana acharina. mila docha et hatztzaraat, may tama? deate ase vedache lo taase. umay "o eno" dekaamar — hadar kaamar: emar deamrinan deate ase vedache et lo taase — lo taase gereda, hay ase velo taase hu. uma ani mekayyem "yimmol besar orlato" — bizman sheen bah baheret, talmud lomar: "basar" — veaf al pi sheyyesh sham baheret.
Tinach gadol, dichtiv beh "basar". katan name, ketiv beh "basar". benoni menalan?

Amar abbaye, atya mibbenayya: miggadol la atya, shekken anush karet. mikkatan la atya, shekken mila bizmannah. hatztzad hashshave shebbahen — shekken nimmolin vedochin et hatztzaraat, af kol shennimmolin — dochin et hatztzaraat.
Rava amar: mila bizmannah docha la tzericha kera, mikkal vachomer atya: uma shabbat dachamira docha — tzaraat lo kol shekken.

Amar leh rav safra lerava: mimmay deshabbat chamira? dilma tzaraat chamira, shekken docha et haavoda, vaavoda docha et hashshabbat! hatam, lav mishshum dachamira tzaraat, ella mishshum degavra hu dela chazi. ammay: veyakotz bahareto veyaavod! mechussar tevila hu.
Tinach negaim temeim. negaim tehorim, may ikka lememar?

Ella amar rav ashe: hecha amrinan deate ase vedache lo taase — kegon mila betzaraat, i name tzitzit vechilayim, dividdana demitakar lav — ka mokem ase. hacha, beiddana demitakar lelav — la ka mokem ase.
Veha, derava verav safra

a: Tannae hi, detanya: "basar" veaf al pi sheyyesh sham baheret — "yimmol", divre rabbi yoshiyya. rabbi yonatan omer: eno tzarich, shabbat chamura — docha, tzaraat — lo kol shekken.
Amar mar: "basar", af al pi sheyyesh sham baheret — "yimmol", divre rabbi yoshiyya. ha lema li kera, davar sheen mitkavven hu, vedavar sheen mitkavven — muttar!

Amar abbaye: la nitzrecha ella lerabbi yehuda, deamar davar sheen mitkavven — asur. rava amar: afillu tema rabbi shimon, mode rabbi shimon bifsik resheh vela yemut". veabbaye let leh hay sevara? veha abbaye verava deamri tarvayyhu: mode rabbi shimon bifsik resheh vela yemut"! batar deshama merava savra.
Ikka dematne leha deabbaye verava aha: "hishshamer benega hatztzaraat lishmor meod velaasot", laasot i atta ose, aval ose atta besiv sheal gabbe raglo, uvemot sheal gabbe ketefo, veim avra — avra.

Veha lema li kera, davar sheen mitkavven hu, vedavar sheen mitkavven — muttar! amar abbaye: lo nitzrecha ella lerabbi yehuda deamar: davar sheen mitkavven — asur. verava amar afillu tema rabbi shimon, mode rabbi shimon bifsik resheh vela yemut". veabbaye let leh hay sevara? veha abbaye verava deamri tarvavyyhu: mode rabbi shimon bifsik resheh vela yemut"! levatar deshameh merava savra.
Veabbaye allibba derabbi shimon, hay "besar" may aved leh? amar rav amram: beomer lakotz bahareto hu mitkavven.
Tinach gadol, katan may ikka lememar? amar rav mesharsheya: beomer avi habben lakotz baheret divno hu ka mitkavven.
Vei ikka acher, lebed acher! deamar rabbi shimon ben lakish: kol makom sheatta motze ase velo taase — im atta yachol lekayyem shenehem mutav, veim lav — yavo ase veyidche lo taase. delekka acher.
Amar mar: yom tov enah docha ella bizmannah bilvad. mena hane mille?
Amar chizkiyya, vechen tana deve chizkiyya, amar kera: "lo totiru mimmennu ad boker", sheen talmud lomar "ad boker", ma talmud lomar "ad boker" — ba hakkatuv litten lo boker sheni lisrefato.
Abbaye amar, amar kera: "olat shabbat beshabbatto", velo olat chol beshabbat, velo olat chol beyom tov.
Rava amar, amar kera: "hu levaddo yease lachem", "hu" — velo machshirin. "levaddo" — velo mila shello bizmannah, deatya mikkal vachomer.
Rav ashe amar: "shabbaton" — ase hu, vehave leh yom tov ase velo taase, veen ase doche et lo taase vaase.
Kelal amar rabbi akiva vechulei. amar rav yehuda amar rav: halacha kerabbi akiva.

Utenan name gabbe fesach ki hay gavvna: kelal amar rabbi akiva: kol melacha sheefshar lah laasotah meerev shabbat — enah docha et hashshabbat. shechita shei efshar laasotah meerev shabbat — docha et hashshabbat. veamar rav yehuda amar rav: halacha kerabbi akiva.
Utzericha, dei ashmeinan gabbe mila: hatam hu demachshirin efshar laasot meetmol la dachu shabbat delekka karet, aval pesach deikka karet — ema lidcho shabbat.
Vei ashmeinan gabbe fesach, mishshum delo nichretu aleha shelosh esre beritot. aval mila denichretu aleha shelosh esre beritot — ema lidcho shabbat, tzericha.
Mishna osin kol tzorche mila [beshabbat]: mohalin uforin umotztzin venotnin aleha ispelanit vechammon.
Im lo shachak meerev shabbat — loes beshinnav venoten. im lo taraf yayin vashemen meerev shabbat — noten ze beatzmo veze beatzmo.
Veen osin lah chaluk lechattechilla, aval korech aleha semartut. im lo hitkin meerev shabbat — korech al etzbao umevi, vaafillu mechatzer acheret.
b: Gemara mikkede katane kullehu, "kol tzorche mila" leetoye may?

Leetoye ha detanu rabbanan: hammal, kol zeman shehu osek bammila — chozer ben al hatztzitzin hameakkevin et hammila ben al hatztzitzin sheen meakkevin et hammila. perash, al tzitzin hameakkevin et hammila — chozer, al tzitzin sheen meakkevin et hammila — eno chozer.

Man tanna perash eno chozer? amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: rabbi yishmael beno shel rabbi yochanan ben beroka hi. detanya: arbaa asar shechal lihyot beshabbat — mafshit adam happesach ad hechaze, divre rabbi yishmael beno shel rabbi yochanan ben beroka. vachachamim omrim: mafshitin et kullo.
Mimmay? ad kan la kaamar rabbi yishmael beno shel rabbi yochanan ben beroka hatam — mishshum dela baenan "ze eli veanvehu". aval hacha — devaenan "ze eli veanvehu", hachi name.

Detanya: "ze eli veanvehu", hitnae lefanav bemitzvot: ase lefanav sukka naa, velulav nae, veshofar nae, tzitzit naa, sefer tora nae, uchetov bo lishmo bidyo nae, bekulemos nae, belavlar umman, vechorcho beshirain nain.
Abba shaul omer: "veanvehu" — heve dome lo, ma hu channun verachum — af atta heye channun verachum.

Ella amar rav ashe: ha manni — rabbi yose hi, ditnan: ben shennira baalil, uven shello nira baalil — mechallelin alav et hashshabbat. rabbi yose omer: nira baalil — en mechallelin alav et hashshabbat.
Mimmay? dilma ad kan la kaamar rabbi yose hatam, delo nittena shabbat liddachot, aval hacha denittena shabbat liddachot — hachi name.

Ella amri nehardae: rabbanan difligi aleh derabbi yose hi. ditnan: arbaa kohanim nichnasin: shenayim beyadam shene sedarim, ushenayim beyadam shene vazikkin. vearbaa makdimin lifnehem: shenayim littol shene sedarim, ushenayim littol shene vazikkin. hammachnisin omdim batztzafon ufenehem laddarom, vehammotziin omdim baddarom ufenehem latztzafon. ellu moshchim, veellu mannichin, tifcho shel ze betzad tifcho shel ze, mishshum shenneemar "lifne Adonai tamid".
Rabbi yose omer: afillu ellu notlin veellu mannichin af ze haya "tamid".
Tanu rabbanan: mehalektin et hammila, veim lo hilket — anush karet. manni? amar rav kahana: umman.
Matkef lah rav pappa: umman lema lehu "ana avadi palga demitzva, attun [name] avidu palga demitzva"! ella amar rav pappa: gadol.

Matkef lah rav ashe: gadol behedya ketiv beh: "vearel zachar asher lo yimmol". ella amar rav ashe: leolam umman, uchegon daata ben hashshemashot deshabbat, vaamaru leh: la maspekat, vaamar lehu: maspekena, vaavad vela istappak, veishtechach dechabbura hu daavad, veanush karet.
Motztzin vechulei. amar rav pappa: hay ummana dela mayetz — sakkana hu umeabberinan leh.
Peshita, middeka mechalleli aleh shabbeta sakkana hu! mahu detema hay dam mifkad pekid, ka mashma lan chabbore michabbar.
Vedumeya deispelanit vechammon: ma ispelanit vechammon ki la aved sakkana hu, af hacha name, ki la aved sakkana hu.
Venotnin aleha ispelanit. amar abbaye, amara li em: ispelanita dechullehon kive — shav mane tarba, vachada kira. rava amar: kira vekalba.
Darsha rava bemachoza, karinhu bene minyome asya lemanayyhu. amar lehu: shevaki lechu chada. daamar shemuel: hay man demashe appeh vela minnaggev tuva — nikteru leh

a: Chaspanita. may takkanteh — limshe tuva bemayya desilka.
Lo shachak meerev shabbat. tanu rabbanan: devarim sheen osin lammila beshabbat — osin lah beyom tov. shochakin lah kammon, vetorfin lah yayin vashemen.

Amar leh abbaye lerav yosef: may shena kammon beyom tov — dachaze likdera, yayin vashemen chaze name beshabbat lechole, detanya: en torfin yayin vashemen lachole beshabbat. amar rabbi shimon ben elazar mishshum rabbi meir: af torfin yayin vashemen.

Amar rabbi shimon ben elazar: paam achat chash rabbi meir bemeav, uvikkashnu litrof lo yayin vashemen velo hinnichanu. amarnu lo: devarecha yivtelu bechayyecha?! amar lanu: af al pi sheani omer kach vachaveray omrim kach — miyyamay lo melaani libbi laavor al divre chaveray. hu nihu demachmir annafsheh, aval lechulle alma — shere!
Hatam — la bae likka, hacha bae likka. hacha name nebed vela lelech! hayeynu dekatane: noten ze bifne atzmo veze bifne atzmo.
Tanu rabbanan: en mesannenin et hachardal bimsannenet shello, veen memattekin oto begachelet. amar leh abbaye lerav yosef: may shena meha ditnan: notnim betza bimsannenet shel chardal?
Amar leh: hatam — la michze kevorer, hacha — michze kevorer.
Veen memattekin oto begachelet. vehatanya: memattekin oto begachelet! la kashya: kan begachelet shel mattechet, kan begachelet shel etz.
Amar leh abbaye lerav yosef: may shena mibbisra aggumere! amar leh: hatam la efshar, hacha efshar.
Amar leh abbaye lerav yosef: mahu legabben? amar leh: asur. may shena millisha? amar leh: hatam la efshar, hacha efshar.
Veha amri nehardae: gevina bat yoma mealleya! hachi kaamri: daafillu gevina bat yoma mealleya.

En osin lah chaluk kulei. amar abbaye, amara li em: hay chaluk deyanoka, lappecheh lesitreh leillay, dilma middevik girda minneh, veate lide kerut shofcha. immeh deabbaye avda kista lefalga. amar abbaye: hay yanoka delet leh chaluk — layyte belita deit leh sifta, velichrecheh lesifta letattay, veayef leh leillay.

Veamar abbaye, amara li em: hay yanoka dela yedia mappakteh, leshayyfeh mishcha velokmeh lahade yoma, vehecha dezig — likreeh bisarta sheti vaerev. aval bichli mattachot — la, mishshum dezaref. veamar abbaye, amara li em: hay yanoka dela mayetz, mekar [hu] dekar pummeh. may takkanteh? layto kasa gumere, velaynketeh leh lahade pummeh, dechayem pummeh umayetz. veamar abbaye, amara li em: hay yanoka dela minnashtem — linpefeh benafvota uminnashtem.

Veamar abbaye, amara li em: hay yanoka dela meavve — layto silta deimmeh velishrekeh illaveh, umeavve. veamar abbaye, amara li em: hay yanoka dekattin, layyto lesilta deimmeh, velishrekeh illaveh mikkutena leulema. vei allim — meulema lekutena. veamar abbaye, amara li em: hay yanoka desummak — deakkatti la ibbela beh demeh — littarchu leh ad demibbela beh demeh, velimhalu. deyarok, deakkatti la nefal beh demeh — littarchu ad denafel beh demeh, velimhalu.

Detanya, amar rabbi natan: paam achat halachti lichrakke hayyam, uvat ishsha achat lefanay shemmala benah rishon vamet, sheni vamet, shelishi, heviattu lefanay, reitiv shehu adom. amarti lah: hametini lo ad sheyyibbala bo damo, himtina lo ad shennivla bo damo, umala oto vechaya, vehayu korin oto "natan habbavli" al shemi.

Shuv paam achat halachti limdinat kappotkeya, uvat ishsha achat lefanay shemmala benah rishon vamet, sheni vamet, shelishi heviattu lefanay, reitiv shehu yarok. hetzatzti bo velo raiti bo dam berit. amarti lah: hametini lo ad sheyyippol bo damo, vehimtina lo umala oto vechaya, vehayu korin shemo "natan habbavli" al shemi.
b: Mishna marchitzin et hakkatan ben lifne hammila uven leachar hammila, umezallefin alav bayyad, aval lo bichli. rabbi elazar ben azarya omer: marchitzin et hakkatan bayyom hashshelishi shechal lihyot beshabbat, shenneemar: "vayhi vayyom hashshelishi bihyotam koavim".
Safek veanderoginos — en mechallelin alav et hashshabbat. verabbi yehuda mattir beanderoginos.
Gemara veha amrat resha marchitzin!
Rav yehuda verabba bar avu deamri tarvayyhu "ketzad" tane: marchitzin et hakkatan ben lifne mila ben leachar mila. ketzad? — mezallefin alav bayyad aval lo bichli.

Amar rava: veha "marchitzin" katane! ella amar rava, hachi katane: marchitzin et hakkatan ben millifne mila ben leachar hammila, bayyom harishon — kedarko, uvayyom hashshelishi shechal lihyot beshabbat — mezallefin alav bayyad, aval lo bichli. rabbi elazar ben azarya omer: marchitzin et hakkatan bayyom hashshelishi shechal lihyot beshabbat, shenneemar: "vayhi vayyom hashshelishi bihyotam koavim".

Tanya kevoteh derava: marchitzin hakkatan ben lifne mila ben leachar mila, beyom harishon — kedarko, uvayyom hashshelishi shechal lihyot beshabbat — mezallefin alav bayyad. rabbi elazar ben azarya omer: marchitzin et hakkatan bayyom hashshelishi shechal lihyot beshabbat. veaf al pi sheen reaya laddavar zecher laddavar, shenneemar: "vayhi vayyom hashshelishi bihyotam koavim".
Ucheshehen mezallefin — en mezallefin lo bechos velo bikara velo bichli, ella bayyad. atan letanna kamma.
May "af al pi sheen reaya laddavar zecher laddavar"? mishshum degadol la salek bisreh hayyay, katan salek (beh) bisreh hayyay.
Hahu daata lekammeh derava, ori leh kishmateh. ichalash rava, amar: ana bahade targuma desave lema li.
Amaru leh rabbanan lerava: vehatanya kevoteh demar? amar lehu: matnitin kevotayyhu dayka.

Mimmay — middekaamar rabbi elazar ben azarya omer: marchitzin et hakkatan beyom hashshelishi shechal lihyot beshabbat. i amrat bishlama tanna kamma "mezallefin" kaamar — hayeynu dekaamar leh rabbi elazar ben azarya "marchitzin". ella i amrat tanna kamma marchitzin beyom harishon kaamar, umezallefin beyom hashshelishi, hay rabbi elazar ben azarya omer marchitzin — "af marchitzin" mibbee leh?
Ki ata rav dimi amar rabbi elazar: halacha kerabbi elazar ben azarya.
Havo ba bemareva: harechatzat kol gufo o harechatzat mila?

Amar lehu hahu merabbanan, verabbi yaakov shemeh: mistabbera harechatzat kol gufo, dei salka datach harechatzat mila, mi gara mechammin al gabbe makka, deamar rav: en monin chammin vashemen meal gabbe makka beshabbat!
Matkef la rav yosef: vela shane lach ben chammin shehuchammu beshabbat lechammin shehuchammu meerev shabbat?

Matkef la rav dimi: umimmay dehacha bechammin shehuchammu beshabbat peligi? dilma bechammin shehuchammu beerev shabbat peligi?! amar abbaye: ana beay deeyshanne leh, ukedam veshanni leh rav yosef: mippene shessakkana hu lo.

Ittemar name, ki ata ravin amar rabbi avahu amar rabbi elazar, veamri la amar rabbi avahu amar rabbi yochanan: halacha kerabbi elazar ben azarya ben bechammin shehuchammu beshabbat, ben bechammin shehuchammu meerev shabbat, ben harechatzat kol gufo, ben harechatzat mila, mippene shessakkana hi lo.
Gufa. amar rav: en monin chammin vashemen meal gabbe makka beshabbat. ushemuel amar: noten chutz lammakka, veshotet veyored lammakka.
Metivi: en notnin shemen vechammin al gabbe moch litten al gabbe makka bashshabbat! hatam mishshum sechita.
Ta shema: en notnin chammin vashemen al gabbe moch, sheal gabbe makka bashshabbat. hatam name mishshum sechita.
Tanya kevoteh dishmuel: en notnin chammin vashemen al gabbe makka bashshabbat, aval notnin chutz lammakka veshotet veyored lammakka.

Tanu rabbanan: notnin al gabbe hammakka moch yavesh usefog yavesh, aval lo gemi yavesh velo ketitin yeveshin. kashya ketitin akketitin! la kashya: ha bechadte, ha beattike. amar abbaye: shema minna hane ketitin massu.
Safek veanderoginos kulei. tanu rabbanan: "orlato" — orlato vadday doche et hashshabbat,

a: Velo safek doche et hashshabbat. "orlato" — vadday doche et hashshabbat, velo anderoginos doche et hashshabbat.

Rabbi yehuda omer: anderoginos doche et hashshabbat, veanush karet. "orlato" — vadday doche et hashshabbat, velo nolad ben hashshemashot doche et hashshabbat. "orlato" — vadday doche et hashshabbat, velo nolad keshehu mahul doche et hashshabbat. shebbet shammay omrim: tzarich lehattif mimmennu dam berit, uvet hillel omrim: eno tzarich.

Amar rabbi shimon ben elazar: lo nechleku bet shammay uvet hillel al nolad keshehu mahul shetztzarich lehattif mimmennu dam berit, mippene sheorla kevusha hi. al ma nechleku — al ger shennitgayyer keshehu mahul, shebbet shammay omrim: tzarich lehattif mimmennu dam berit, uvet hillel omrim: en tzarich lehattif mimmennu dam berit.

Amar mar: velo safek doche et hashshabbat. leetoye may? leetoye ha detanu rabbanan: ben shiva, mechallelin alav et hashshabbat. uven shemona, en mechallelin alav et hashshabbat. safek ben shiva safek ben shemona — en mechallelin alav et hashshabbat.
Ben shemona — hare hu keeven, veasur letaltelo. aval immo shocha umenikato mippene hassakkana.
Ittemar, rav amar: halacha ketanna kamma, ushemuel amar: halacha kerabbi shimon ben elazar.
Rav adda bar ahava ityelid leh hahu yanoka keshehu mahul. ahdereh attelesar maholae, ad deshavveyeh kerut shafcha. amar: tete li, daavari adderav.

Amar leh rav nachman: veaddishmuel la avar?! emar deamar shemuel bachol, beshabbat mi amar? hu savar, vadday orla kevusha hi. deittemar, rabba amar: chayyshinan shemma orla kevusha hi. rav yosef amar: vadday orla kevusha hi.

Amar rav yosef: mena amena la — detanya, rabbi eliezer hakkappar omer: lo nechleku bet shammay uvet hillel al nolad keshehu mahul — shetztzarich lehattif mimmennu dam berit, al ma nechleku — lechallel alav et hashshabbat. bet shammay omrim mechallelin alav et hashshabbat, uvet hillel omrim: en mechallelin alav et hashshabbat. lav mikkelal detanna kamma savar mechallelin alav et hashshabbat?!
Vedilma tanna kamma divre hakkol en mechallelin kaamar! im ken — rabbi eliezer hakkappar tama devet shammay ata leashmoinan? dilma hachi kaamar: lo nechleku bet shammay uvet hillel bedavar ze.

Amar rabbi assi kol sheimmo temea leda — nimmol lishmona, vechol sheen immo temea leda — en nimmol lishmona, shenneemar: "ishsha ki tazria veyalda zachar vetama vegomer uvayyom hashshemini yimmol besar orlato".
Amar leh abbaye: dorot harishonim yochichu, sheen immo temea leda, venimmol lishmona!
Amar leh: nittena tora,
b: Venitchaddesha halacha.

Ini? veha ittemar: yotze dofen umi sheyyesh lo shete aralot, rav huna verav chiyyay bar rav, chad amar: mechallelin alav et hashshabbat. vechad amar: en mechallelin. ad kan la peligi ella lechallel alav et hashshabbat, aval lishmona — vadday mahalinan leh! ha beha talya.
Ketannae: yesh yelid bayit shennimmol leechad veyesh yelid bayit shennimmol lishmona, yesh miknat kesef shennimmol leechad veyesh miknat kesef shennimmol lishmona.

Yesh miknat kesef shennimmol leechad veyesh miknat kesef shennimmol lishmona, ketzad? lakach shifcha meubberet veachar kach yalda — zehu miknat kesef hannimmol lishmona. lakach shifcha uveladah immah — zo hi miknat kesef shennimmol leechad.

Veyesh yelid bayit shennimmol lishmona, ketzad? lakach shifcha venitabbera etzlo veyalda — zehu yelid bayit hannimmol lishmona. rav chama omer: yalda veachar kach hitbilah — zehu yelid bayit shennimmol leechad. hitbilah veachar kach yalda — zehu yelid bayit hannimmol lishmona.
Vetanna kamma la shane leh ben hitbilah veachar kach yalda ben yalda veachar kach hitbilah, deaf al gav deen immo temea leda, nimmol lishmona.

Amar rava: bishlama lerabbi chama, mashkachat la yelid bayit nimmol leechad, yelid bayit nimmol lishmona, miknat kesef nimmol leechad umiknat kesef nimmol lishmona: yalda veachar kach hitbilah — zehu yelid bayit shennimmol leechad. hitbilah veachar kach yalda — zehu yelid bayit shennimmol lishmona.
Miknat kesef nimmol lishmona — kegon shellakach shifcha meubberet vehitbilah veachar kach yalda. miknat kesef nimmol leechad — kegon shellakach ze shifcha, veze ubbarah.
Ella letanna kamma, bishlama kullehu mashkachat lehu, ella yelid bayit nimmol leechad hechi mashkachat la?
Amar rabbi yirmeya: belokeach shifcha leubbarah.
Hanicha leman deamar kinyan perot lav kekinyan hagguf dame. ella leman deamar kinyan perot kekinyan hagguf dame may ikka lememar?
Amar rav mesharsheya: belokeach shifcha al menat shello lehatebilah.

Tanya: rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: kol sheshshaha sheloshim yom, baadam — eno nefel, shenneemar: "ufeduyav mibben chodesh tifde". shemonat yamim babbehema — eno nefel, shenneemar: "umiyyom hashshemini vahala yeratze lekorban vegomer".
Ha lo shaha — sefeka have,

a: Mimhal hechi mahalinan leh!
Amar rav adda bar ahava: malin oto mimma nafshach: im chay hu — shappir ka mahel, veim lav — mechattech bevasar hu.
Veella ha detanya: safek ben shiva, safek ben shemona — en mechallelin alav et hashshabbat, ammay? nimhaleh mimma nafshach! im chay hu — shappir ka mahel, veim lav — mechattech bevasar hu!
Amar mar bereh deravina: ana verav nechumi bar zecharya targemna: mimhal — hachi name mahalinan leh. lo nitzrecha ella lemachshire mila, veallibba derabbi eliezer.

Amar abbaye, ketannae: "vechi yamut min habbehema asher hi lachem leochla", lehavi ben shemone sheen shechitato metaharto. rabbi yose berabbi yehuda verabbi elazar berabbi shimon omrim: shechitato metaharto.
May lav beha ka mippalgi: demar savar chay hu, umar savar met hu.
Amar rava: i hachi, addemippalgi leinyan tumea vetohora, lippalgi leinyan achila!

Ella dechulle alma met hu, verabbi yose berabbi yehuda verabbi elazar berabbi shimon savri kitrefa: terefa lav af al gav demeta hi — shechitatah metahartah, hacha name — la shena. verabbanan: la dame litrefa, terefa — hayta lah sheat hakkosher, hay — lo hayta lah sheat hakkosher.
Vechi tema: terefa mibbeten, may ikka lememar? hatam — yesh beminah shechita, hacha — en beminah shechita.
Ibbaya lehu: mi peligi rabbanan aleh derabban shimon ben gamliel, o la? im timtze lomar peligi, halacha kemoto, o en halacha kemoto?
Ta shema: egel shennolad beyom tov — shochatin oto beyom tov! hacha bemay askinan, dekim leh begavvevy shekkalu lo chodashav.
Ta shema: veshavin, sheim nolad hu umumo immo — shezze min hammuchan! hacha name shekkalu lo chodashav.
Ta shema, deamar rav yehuda amar shemuel: halacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel. halacha — mikkelal difligi. shema minna.
Amar abbaye: nafal min haggag o achalo ari — divre hakkol chay hu. ki peligi sheppihek vamet. mar savar: chay hu, umar savar: met hu.
Lemay nafka minneh? liftor min hayyibbum.

Nafal min haggag o achalo ari — divre hakkol chay hu? veha rav pappa verav huna bereh derav yehoshua ikkelau leve bereh derav idi bar avin, vaavadu lehu igla tilta bimama deshiva. veamri leh: i ittarchitu leh ad leureta — hava achlinan minneh, hasheta — la achlinan minneh!
Ella: kesheppihek vamet — divre hakkol met hu, ki peligi benafal min haggag vaachalo ari, mar savar: met hu, umar savar chay hu.
Bereh derav dimi bar yosef ityelid leh hahu yanoka. bego telatin yomin shechev. yatev kamitabbel illaveh. amar leh avu: tzevoronyata kavaet lemechal? amar leh: kim li beh shekkalu lo chodashav.

Rav ashe ikkela leve rav kahana. ittera beh milleta bego telatin yomin. chazyeh deyatev veka mitabbal illaveh. amar leh: la savar leh mar leha deamar rav yehuda amar shemuel: halacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel? amar leh: kim li begavveh shekkalu lo chodashav.
Ittemar: met betoch sheloshim, veamda venitkaddesha. amar ravina mishshemeh derava:
b: Im eshet yisrael hi — choletzet. im eshet kohen hi — enah choletzet.
Verav sherevya mishshemeh derava amar: achat zo veachat zo — choletzet.
Amar leh ravina lerav sherevya: beureta amar rava hachi, letzafra hadar beh. amar leh sherituha? yehe raava detishro tarba.
Rabbi yehuda mattir vechulei. amar rav shezvi amar rav chisda: lo lakkol amar rabbi yehuda anderoginos zachar hu, sheim atta omer ken, baarachin yearech!

Umenalan dela miarach? detanya: "hazzachar" — velo tumetum veanderoginos. yachol lo yehe beerech ish aval yehe beerech ishsha — talmud lomar: "hazzachar", "veim nekeva hi". zachar vadday, nekeva vaddait — velo tumetum veanderoginos.

a: Usetam sifra rabbi yehuda.
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: af anan name tenena: hakkol kesherim lekaddesh, chutz mecheresh shote vekatan. rabbi yehuda machshir bekatan ufosel beishsha veanderoginos. shema minna.
Umay shena mila? mishshum dichtiv: "himmol lachem kol zachar".
Mishna mi shehayu lo shene tinokot, echad lamul achar hashshabbat veechad lamul bashshabbat, veshachach umal et shel achar hashshabbat bashshabbat — chayyayv.
Echad lamul beerev shabbat veechad lamul bashshabbat, veshachach umal et shel erev shabbat bashshabbat — rabbi eliezer mechayyev chattat, verabbi yehoshua poter.
Gemara rav huna matne "chayyayv", rav yehuda matne "patur".

Rav huna matne "chayyayv", detanya, amar rabbi shimon ben elazar: lo nechleku rabbi elazar verabbi yehoshua al mi shehayu lo shene tinokot, echad lamul bashshabbat veechad lamul achar hashshabbat, veshachach umal et shel achar hashshabbat bashshabbat — shehu chayyayv.

Al ma nechleku — al mi shehayu lo shene tinokot, echad lamul beerev shabbat veechad lamul bashshabbat, veshachach umal et shel erev shabbat bashshabbat — sherabbi eliezer mechayyev chattat, verabbi yehoshua poter.
Ushenehem lo lemaduha ella meavoda zara. rabbi eliezer savar: kaavoda zara, ma avoda zara amar rachamana "la taaved", vechi avid — michayyayv, hacha name — la shena.
Verabbi yehoshua: hatam — delav mitzva, hacha — mitzva.

Rav yehuda matne "patur", detanya, amar rabbi meir: lo nechleku rabbi eliezer verabbi yehoshua al mi shehayu lo shene tinokot, echad lamul beerev shabbat veechad lamul bashshabbat, veshachach umal et shel erev shabbat bashshabbat — shehu patur.

Al ma nechleku — al mi shehayu lo shene tinokot, echad lamul achar hashshabbat veechad lamul bashshabbat, veshachach umal et shel achar hashshabbat bashshabbat — sherabbi eliezer mechayyev chattat, verabbi yehoshua poter.
Ushenehem lo lemaduha ella meavoda zara. rabbi eliezer savar: kaavoda zara, ma avoda zara amar rachamana "la taaved", vechi aved — michayyayv, hacha name — la shena.
Verabbi yehoshua: hatam — la terid [b]mitzva, hacha — terid.

Tane rabbi chiyyay: omer haya rabbi meir, lo nechleku rabbi eliezer verabbi yehoshua al mi shehayu lo shene tinokot, echad lamul beerev shabbat veechad lamul bashshabbat, veshachach umal et shel erev shabbat bashshabbat — shehu chayyayv.

Al ma nechleku — al mi shehayu lo shene tinokot, echad lamul achar hashshabbat veechad lamul bashshabbat, veshachach umal shel achar hashshabbat bashshabbat — sherabbi eliezer mechayyev chattat verabbi yehoshua poter.
Hasheta rabbi yehoshua sefa dela ka aved mitzva — poter, resha, deka aved mitzva — mechayyev?!
Amri deve rabbi yannay: resha, kegon shekkadam umal shel shabbat beerev shabbat, delo nittena shabbat liddachot. sefa nittena shabbat liddachot.
Amar leh rav ashe lerav kahana: resha name nittena shabbat liddachot legabbe tinokot dealma! lehay gavra miha la ityehiv.
Mishna katan nimmol lishmona, letisha, velaasara, uleachad asar, velishnem asar, lo pachot velo yoter.
Ha ketzad? kedarko — lishmona. nolad leven hashshemashot — nimmol letisha. ben hashshemashot shel erev shabbat — nimmol laasara.
Yom tov leachar hashshabbat — nimmol leachad asar. shene yamim shel rosh hashshana — nimmol lishnem asar.
Katan hachole — en mohalin oto ad sheyyavri.
Gemara amar shemuel: chalatzattu chamma — notnin lo kol shiva lehaveroto.
Ibbaya lehu: mi baenan meet leet?
Ta shema, detane ludda: yom haveraato keyom hivvaldo. may lav: ma yom hivvaldo la baenan meet leet — af yom haveraato la baenan meet leet.
La, adif yom haveraato miyyom hivvaldo, deillu yom hivvaldo — la baenan meet leet, veillu yom haveraato — baenan meet leet.
Mishna ellu hen tzitzin hameakkevin et hammila: basar hachofe et rov haatara, veeno ochel bitruma.
Veim haya baal basar — metakkeno, mippene marit haayin.
b: Mal velo para et hammila — keillu lo mal.
Gemara amar rabbi avina amar rabbi yirmeya bar abba amar rav: basar hachofe et rov govhah shel atara.
Veim haya baal basar vechulei. amar shemuel: katan hamesurebal bevasar, roin oto, kol zeman shemmitkashshe venire mahul — eno tzarich lamul, veim lav — tzarich lamul.
Bematnita tana, rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: katan hamesurebal bevasar, roin oto, kol zeman shemmitkashshe veeno nire mahul — tzarich lemulo, veim lav — eno tzarich lemulo.
May benayyhu? ikka benayyhu, nire veeno nire.

Mal velo para. tanu rabbanan, hammal omer: "asher kiddeshanu bemitzvotav vetzivvanu al hammila". avi habben omer: "asher kiddeshanu bemitzvotav vetzivvanu lehacheniso bivrito shel avraham avinu". haomdim omrim: "keshem shennichnas labberit, kach yikkanes letora lechuppa ulemaasim tovim".

Vehamevarech omer: "asher kiddesh yadid mibbeten, chok bishero sam, vetzeetzaav chatam beot berit kodesh. al ken bischar zot el chay chelkenu [tzurenu], tzivva lehatztzil yedidut sheerenu mishshachat lemaan berito asher sam bivsarenu. baruch atta Adonai koret habberit".

Hammal et haggerim omer: "baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam asher kiddeshanu bemitzvotav vetzivvanu al hammila", vehamevarech omer: "asher kiddeshanu bemitzvotav vetzivvanu lamul et haggerim ulehattif mehem dam berit, sheilmale dam berit lo nitkayyeymu shamayim vaaretz, shenneemar: 'im lo veriti yomam valayla chukkot shamayim vaaretz lo samti. baruch atta Adonai koret habberit".

Hammal et haavadim omer: "asher kiddeshanu bemitzvotav vetzivvanu al hammila", vehamevarech omer: "asher kiddeshanu bemitzvotav vetzivvanu lamul et haavadim ulehattif mehem dam berit, sheilmale dam berit chukkot shamayim vaaretz lo nitkayyeymu, shenneemar: 'im lo veriti yomam valayla chukkot shamayim vaaretz lo samti. baruch atta Adonai koret habberit".
Haderan alach rabbi eliezer demila

Mishna rabbi eliezer omer: tolin et hameshammeret beyom tov, venotnin latteluya bashshabbat. vachachamim omrim: en tolin et hameshammeret beyom tov, veen notnin latteluya bashshabbat, aval notnin latteluya beyom tov.
Gemara hasheta rabbi eliezer osofe ohel aray la mosfinan, lemibad lechattechilla shere?!
May hi — ditnan: pekak hachallon, rabbi eliezer omer: bizman shekkashur vetaluy — pokkin bo, veim lav — en pokkin bo. vachachamim omrim: ben kach uven kach — pokkin bo.

Veamar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: hakkol modim sheen osin ohel aray battechilla beyom tov, veen tzarich lomar bashshabbat. lo nechleku ella lehosif, sherabbi eliezer omer: en mosifin beyom tov, veen tzarich lomar bashshabbat. vachachamim omrim: mosifin bashshabbat, veen tzarich lomar beyom tov.
Rabbi eliezer savar la kerabbi yehuda. detanya: en ben yom tov lashshabbat ella ochel nefesh bilvad. rabbi yehuda mattir af machshire ochel nefesh.
Emar deshaminan leh lerabbi yehuda bemachshirin shei efshar laasotam meerev yom tov, bammachshirin sheefshar laasotam meerev yom tov mi shamat leh?!
Derabbi eliezer adifa midderabbi yehuda.
Vachachamim omrim. ibbaya lehu: tala may? amar rav yosef: tala — chayyayv chattat.
Amar leh abbaye: ella meatta, tela kuza besikketa hachi name demichayyayv?!

a: Ella amar abbaye: midderabbanan hi, shello yaase kederech shehu ose bachol.

Menakket abbaye chumere matneyata vetane: haggod vehameshammeret, killa vechisse gallin — lo yaase, veim asa — patur aval asur. ohole keva — lo yaase, veim asa — chayyayv chattat. aval mitta vechisse teraskal veasla — muttar lintotan lechattechilla.
Veen notnin latteluya bashshabbat. ibbaya lehu: shimmer may? amar rav kahana: shimmer — chayyayv chattat.
Matkef la rav sheshet: mi ikka midde derabbanan mechayyeyvi chattat, verabbi eliezer share lechattechilla?!
Matkef la rav yosef: allema la? hare ir shel zahav, derabbi meir mechayyev chattat, verabbi eliezer share lechattechilla.

May hi — detanya: lo tetze ishsha beir shel zahav, veim yatza — chayyevet chattat, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim: lo tetze, veim yatza petura. rabbi eliezer omer: yotza ishsha beir shel zahav lechattechilla.
Amar leh abbaye: mi savrat rabbi eliezer adderabbi meir kae, deamar chayyevet chattat? adderabbanan kae, deamri patur aval asur, vaamar lehu ihu muttar lechattechilla.
Mishshum may matrinan beh? rabba amar: mishshum borer. rabbi zera amar: mishshum merakked.
Amar rabba, kevoti didi mistabbera: ma darko shel borer — notel ochel umanniach happesolet, af hacha name: notel et haochel umanniach et happesolet.
Amar rabbi zera, kevoti didi mistabbera: ma darko shel merakked — pesolet millemala veochel millematta, af hacha name: pesolet millemala veochel millematta.
Tane rame bar yechezkel: tallit kefula lo yaase, veim asa — patur aval asur. haya karuch aleha chut o meshicha — muttar lintotah lechattechilla.
Bea minneh rav kahana merav: killa mahu? amar leh: af mitta asura. mitta mahu? amar leh: af killa mutteret. killa umitta mahu? amar leh: killa asura umitta mutteret.
Vela kashya. ha dekaamar af mitta asura — kidkarmonae. ha dekaamar leh af killa mutteret — kidrame bar yechezkel. killa asura umitta mutteret — kiddidan.
Amar rav yosef: chazena lehu lechille deve rav huna demeureta negida umitztzafra chavita ramya.
Amar rav mishshum rabbi chiyyay: vilon muttar lintoto umuttar leforko.
Veamar shemuel mishshum rabbi chiyyay:
b: Killat chatanim muttar lintotah umuttar leforkah.

Amar rav sheshet bereh derav idi: la amaran ella sheen begaggah tefach, aval yesh begaggah tefach — asura. vechi en begaggah tefach name la amaran ella sheen befachot mishshelosha samuch legaggah tefach, aval yesh befachot mishshelosha samuch legaggah tefach — asur. vela amaran ella sheen beshippuah tefach, aval yesh beshippuah tefach — shippue ohalim keohalim damu. vela amaran ella dela nachet mippureya tefach, aval nachet mippureya tefach — asur.
Veamar rav sheshet bereh derav idi: hay seyana share. vehaittemar: seyana asur! la kashya: ha deit beh tefach, ha delet beh tefach.
Ella meatta, sharbev biglima tefach hachi name demichayyayv? ella la kashya: ha demihaddak, ha dela mihaddak.
Shelach leh rame bar yechezkel lerav huna: ema lan izi hanach mille mealleyayta daamart lan mishshemeh derav, tarte beshabbat vachada betora.
Shelach leh: ha detanya god bechisana muttar lintotah beshabbat — amar rav: lo shanu ella bishne bene adam, aval beadam echad — asur.
Amar abbaye: vechilla afillu baasara bene adam asur. i efshar dela mimmatcha pureta.
Iddach may hi detanya: kira shennishmeta achat miyyarchoteha — muttar letaltelah. shetayim — asur. rav amar: afillu chad name asur, gezera shemma yitka.

Tora — deamar rav: atida tora shettishtakkach miyyisrael, shenneemar: "vehifla Adonai et makkotcha", hafelaa zo eni yodea mahi. keshehu omer: "lachen hinni yosif lehafeli et haam hazze hafele vafele" — heve omer: hafelaa zo tora.

Tanu rabbanan: keshennichnesu rabbotenu lakkerem beyavne amru, atida tora shettishtakkach miyyisrael, shenneemar: "hinne yamim baim neum Adonai elohim vehishlachti raav baaretz lo raav lallechem velo tzama lammayim ki im lishmoa et divre Adonai", uchetiv: "venau miyyam ad yam umitztzafon vead mizrach yeshottu levakkesh et devar Adonai velo yimtzau".
"Devar Adonai" — zo halacha, "devar Adonai" — ze hakketz, "devar Adonai" — zo nevua.
Umay "yeshottu levakkesh et devar Adonai"? amru: atida ishsha shettittol kikkar shel teruma vetachazor bevatte chenesiyyot uvevatte midrashot leda im temea hi veim tehora hi, veen mevin.
Im tehora hi veim temea hi behedya ketiv beh: "mikkol haochel asher yeachel"! ella: leda im rishona hi veim sheniyya hi, veen mevin.
Ha name matnitin hi? keditnan: hashsheretz shennimtza battannur — happat shebbetocho sheniyya, shehattannur techilla.
Mistappeka lehu ha daamar leh rav adda bar ahava lerava: lechzeyeh lehay tannura keman dimle tumea vetihve pat rishona!

Amar leh: la amrinan lechzeyeh lehay tannura keman dimle tumea. detanya: yachol yehu kol hakkelim mittammein baavir keli cheres, talmud lomar: "kol asher betocho yitma", "mikkol haochel asher yeachel" — ochalin mittammein baavir keli cheres, veen kelim mittammein baavir keli cheres.

Tanya, rabbi shimon ben yochay omer: chas veshalom shettishtakkach tora miyyisrael, shenneemar: "ki lo tishshachach mippi zaro". ella ma ani mekayyem "yeshottu levakkesh et devar Adonai velo yimtzau"? shello yimtzeu
